Что из описанного в данном блоке относится к функциональным требованиям системы управления безопасностью? Выберите ОДИН вариант ответа.
options: Процедуры уведомления об аварийных ситуациях и выявленных несоответствиях.
Планирование рейсов.
Предоставление руководств по техническому обслуживанию главного двигателя.
Система управления внеплановым техническим обслуживанием.
CD0005 — ISM Code.answer: Процедуры уведомления об аварийных ситуациях и выявленных несоответствиях.

CD0005 — ISM Code.question: Bu modülde, Güvenlik Yönetim Sistemi’nin işlevsel gerekliliklerinden biri olarak aşağıdakilerden HANGİSİ açıklanmıştır?
options: Kazaları ve uygunsuzlukları raporlama prosedürü
Sefer Planlama
Ana makine bakım kılavuzlarının tedarik edilmesi
Planlanmamış bakım görevlerini yönetmek için kullanılacak bir sistem
CD0005 — ISM Code.answer: Kazaları ve uygunsuzlukları raporlama prosedürü

CD0005 — ISM Code.question: Which ONE of the following is described in this module as a functional requirement of a Safety Management System?
options: Procedures to report accidents and non-conformities
Voyage planning
The supply of main engine maintenance manuals
A system for managing unplanned maintenance tasks
CD0005 — ISM Code.answer: Procedures to report accidents and non-conformities

CD0005 — ISM Code.question: Parmi les choix suivants, quel est CELUI qui correspond à l'exigence fonctionnelle décrite dans ce module d'un Système de gestion de la sécurité ?
options: Les procédures de notification des accidents et défauts de conformité
La planification des voyages
Les principaux manuels d'entretien des moteurs
Un système de gestion des tâches d'entretien non planifiées
CD0005 — ISM Code.answer: Les procédures de notification des accidents et défauts de conformité

CD0005 — ISM Code.question: 下列哪一项是本模块所述的安全管理体系职能要求？
options: 报告事故与违规行为的流程
航行规划
提供主要轮机保养手册
计划外养护任务管理体系
CD0005 — ISM Code.answer: 报告事故与违规行为的流程

CD0005 — ISM Code.question: Escolha UMA resposta que é descrita neste módulo como um requisito funcional de um Sistema de Gerenciamento de Segurança?
options: Procedimentos para notificação de acidentes e não conformidades
Planejamento de viagem
O suprimento de manuais de manutenção do motor principal
Um sistema para gerenciar tarefas de manutenção inesperadas
CD0005 — ISM Code.answer: Procedimentos para notificação de acidentes e não conformidades

CD0005 — ISM Code.question: ¿CUÁL de los siguientes se describe en este módulo como un requisito funcional de un sistema de gestión de seguridad?
options: Procedimientos para comunicar accidentes e incumplimientos
Planificación de travesías
El suministro de manuales de mantenimiento del motor principal
Un sistema para gestionar las tareas de mantenimiento no planificadas
CD0005 — ISM Code.answer: Procedimientos para comunicar accidentes e incumplimientos

CD0005 — ISM Code.question: 다음 중 안전 관리 시스템의 기능 요건으로서 본 모듈에서 설명된 것은 무엇입니까?
options: 사고 및 부적합성을 보고하는 절차
항해 계획
주요 엔진 유지보수 설명서 공급
미계획 유지보수 작업 관리를 위한 시스템
CD0005 — ISM Code.answer: 사고 및 부적합성을 보고하는 절차

CD0005 — ISM Code.question: Quale tra le opzioni seguenti è descritta in questo modulo come requisito funzionale di un sistema di gestione della sicurezza?
options: Le procedure per segnalare incidenti e non conformità
La pianificazione della rotta
La fornitura dei manuali di manutenzione del motore principale
Un sistema di gestione delle attività di manutenzione non pianificate
CD0005 — ISM Code.answer: Le procedure per segnalare incidenti e non conformità

CD0005 — ISM Code.question: На какие улучшения направлено действие МКУБ? Выберите ОДИН наиболее подходящий вариант ответа.
options: Организация системы управления компании в сфере безопасности и предотвращения загрязнения.
Отправка докладов с судна в судоходную компанию.
Выдача допусков на производство работ.
Организация системы связи между судном и береговыми службами.
CD0005 — ISM Code.answer: Организация системы управления компании в сфере безопасности и предотвращения загрязнения.

CD0005 — ISM Code.question: I.S.M Kodu neyi geliştirmeyi amaçlar? En iyi BİR cevap seçin.
options: Şirket yönetiminin güvenlik ve kirliliği önlemeye ilişkin örgütlenmesi
Gemiden Şirket'e gönderilen raporlar
Çalışma izinleri çıkarma prosedürü
Kıyı ile gemi arasında kullanılan iletişim sistemleri
CD0005 — ISM Code.answer: Şirket yönetiminin güvenlik ve kirliliği önlemeye ilişkin örgütlenmesi

CD0005 — ISM Code.question: What does the I.S.M. Code aim to improve? Select the ONE best answer .
options: The organisation of company management in relation to safety and pollution prevention
The reports which are sent from ship to company
The procedure for issuing work permits
The communication systems used between shore and ship
CD0005 — ISM Code.answer: The organisation of company management in relation to safety and pollution prevention

CD0005 — ISM Code.question: Quelles sont les améliorations visées par le Code ISM ? Sélectionnez une SEULE réponse, selon celle qui vous semble la meilleure.

Les rapports qui sont transmis par le navire à la compagnie
La procédure de délivrance des permis de travail
Les systèmes de communication reliant le quai et le navire
CD0005 — ISM Code.answer: L'organisation de la gestion de la compagnie en matière de sécurité et de prévention de la pollution

CD0005 — ISM Code.question: I.S.M. Code 的目标是要进行哪些方面的改善？ 请选择一个最佳答案。
options: 与安全和防污染相关的公司管理机构
从船只发送至公司的报告
作业许可证发放程序
岸上与船只之间使用的通信系统
CD0005 — ISM Code.answer: 与安全和防污染相关的公司管理机构

CD0005 — ISM Code.question: O que o código I.S.M. deseja melhorar? Selecione UMA melhor resposta.
options: A organização do gerenciamento da companhia em relação à segurança e prevenção de poluição
As notificações que são enviadas do navio para a companhia
O procedimento para emissão de permissões de trabalho
Os sistemas de comunicação usados entre embarcação e terra
CD0005 — ISM Code.answer: A organização do gerenciamento da companhia em relação à segurança e prevenção de poluição

CD0005 — ISM Code.question: ¿Qué pretende mejorar el código IGS? Seleccione LA mejor respuesta.
options: La organización de la gestión de la empresa respecto a la seguridad y la prevención de la contaminación
Los informes que se envían del barco a la empresa
El procedimiento de emisión de permisos de trabajo
Los sistemas de comunicación empleados entre el personal de tierra y el barco
CD0005 — ISM Code.answer: La organización de la gestión de la empresa respecto a la seguridad y la prevención de la contaminación

CD0005 — ISM Code.question: I.S.M. 강령이 개선하려 하는 것은 무엇입니까? 가장 적합한 답을 하나 선택하십시오.
options: 안전 및 오염 예방과 관련된 회사 관리 조직
선박에서 회사로 전송하는 보고서
작업 승인서 발행 절차
해안과 선박 간 사용되는 통신 시스템
CD0005 — ISM Code.answer: 안전 및 오염 예방과 관련된 회사 관리 조직

CD0005 — ISM Code.question: Cosa aspira a migliorare il codice ISM? Selezionare UNA SOLA risposta.
options: L'organizzazione della gestione della compagnia in relazione alla sicurezza e alla prevenzione dell'inquinamento
Le segnalazioni che vengono inviate dalla nave alla compagnia
La procedura per rilasciare i permessi di lavoro
I sistemi di comunicazione usati tra il personale a terra e la nave
CD0005 — ISM Code.answer: L'organizzazione della gestione della compagnia in relazione alla sicurezza e alla prevenzione dell'inquinamento

CD0005 — ISM Code.question: Как часто, согласно МКУБ, компания должна проводить внутренний аудит СУБ? Выберите ОДИН правильный вариант ответа.
options: Не реже 1 раза в год.
Каждые 6 месяцев.

Каждые 5 лет.
CD0005 — ISM Code.answer: Не реже 1 раза в год.

CD0005 — ISM Code.question: ISM Kodu şirketin ne sıklıkta GYS'nin çalışmasıyla ilgili iç denetim yapmasını gerektirir? BİR doğru cevap seçin.
options: Yılda en az bir kez
6 ayda bir
5 yılda iki kez
5 yılda bir kez
CD0005 — ISM Code.answer: Yılda en az bir kez

CD0005 — ISM Code.question: How often does the I.S.M. Code require the company to carry out an internal audit of the S.M.S.? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: At least once a year
Every 6 months
Twice in 5 years
Every 5 years
CD0005 — ISM Code.answer: At least once a year

CD0005 — ISM Code.question: Combien de fois le Code ISM oblige-t-il la compagnie à effectuer un audit interne du SGS ? Sélectionnez LA réponse correcte.
options: Au moins une fois par an
Tous les 6 mois
Deux fois tous les 5 ans
Tous les 5 ans
CD0005 — ISM Code.answer: Au moins une fois par an

CD0005 — ISM Code.question: I.S.M. Code 规定公司应多长时间对 S.M.S. 进行一次内部审核？ 请选择一个正确答案。

每 6 个月
5 年两次
5 年一次
CD0005 — ISM Code.answer: 每年至少一次

CD0005 — ISM Code.question: Com que frequência o Código I.S.M. exige que a companhia realize uma auditoria interna do funcionamento do S.M.S.? Selecione UMA resposta correta.
options: Pelo menos uma vez por ano
A cada 6 meses
Duas vezes a cada 5 anos
A cada 5 anos
CD0005 — ISM Code.answer: Pelo menos uma vez por ano

CD0005 — ISM Code.question: ¿Cada cuánto tiempo precisa el código IGS que la empresa lleve a cabo una auditoría interna del SMS? Seleccione la ÚNICA respuesta correcta.
options: Una vez al año, como mínimo
Cada seis meses
Dos veces cada cinco años
Cada cinco años
CD0005 — ISM Code.answer: Una vez al año, como mínimo

CD0005 — ISM Code.question: I.S.M. 강령이 얼마나 자주 회사 측에 S.M.S. 내부 감사 실행을 요구합니까? 올바른 답을 하나 선택하십시오.
options: 연 1회 이상
6개월마다
5년마다 2회
5년마다
CD0005 — ISM Code.answer: 연 1회 이상

CD0005 — ISM Code.question: Con quale frequenza il codice ISM richiede alla compagnia di condurre verifiche interne dell'SMS? Selezionare l'UNICA risposta esatta.
options: Almeno una volta l'anno
Ogni 6 mesi
Due volte ogni 5 anni
Ogni 5 anni
CD0005 — ISM Code.answer: Almeno una volta l'anno

CD0005 — ISM Code.question: Дайте определение понятия «несоответствие» согласно МКУБ. Выберите ОДИН правильный вариант ответа.

Аварийная ситуация, произошедшая с кем-либо на борту.
CD0005 — ISM Code.answer: Ситуация, когда объективные данные указывают на невыполнение определенного требования СУБ.

CD0005 — ISM Code.question: ISM Kodu'na göre "uygunsuzluk" teriminin tanımı nedir? BİR doğru cevap seçin.

Denetçinin GYS'deki bir gerekliliğin karşılanmadığını düşündüğü bir durumdur
Geminin, gideceği yere zamanında ulaşamama durumu
Gemide herhangi bir kişinin kaza geçirmesi durumdur
CD0005 — ISM Code.answer: Tarafsız kanıtın GYS tarafından belirtilen özel bir gerekliliği yerine getirmediğini gösterdiği bir durumdur

CD0005 — ISM Code.question: According to the I.S.M. Code, what is the definition of a “non-conformity”? Select the ONE correct answer.

A situation where an auditor thinks that a requirement in the S.M.S. has not been met
A situation where the ship fails to get to its destination on time
A situation where someone has an accident on-board
CD0005 — ISM Code.answer: A situation where objective evidence indicates the non-fulfilment of a specific requirement stated by the S.M.S.

CD0005 — ISM Code.question: Conformément au Code SGS, quelle est la définition d'un « défaut de conformité » ? Sélectionnez LA réponse correcte.
options: Une situation constatée dans laquelle des preuves objectives démontrent qu'une prescription spécifiée par le SGS n'a pas été observée
Une situation où un auditeur pense qu'une prescription du SGS n'a pas été respectée
Une situation où le navire n'atteint pas sa destination à temps
Une situation où une personne est victime d'un accident à bord
CD0005 — ISM Code.answer: Une situation constatée dans laquelle des preuves objectives démontrent qu'une prescription spécifiée par le SGS n'a pas été observée

CD0005 — ISM Code.question: 根据 I.S.M. Code 的规定，“违规事件”的定义是什么？ 请选择一个正确答案。

审核人员认为未达到 S.M.S 中要求的情况
船只无法按时到达目的地的情况
船上有人发生事故的情况
CD0005 — ISM Code.answer: 客观证据表明不符合 S.M.S 特定要求的情况

CD0005 — ISM Code.question: De acordo com o código I.S.M., qual é a definição de uma "não conformidade"? Selecione UMA resposta correta.
options: Uma situação em que evidências objetivas indicam o não cumprimento de um requisito especificado pelo S.M.S.
Uma situação em que o auditor pensa que um requisito do S.M.S. não foi atendido
Uma situação em que o navio não chega ao destino a tempo
Uma situação em que alguém sofre um acidente a bordo
CD0005 — ISM Code.answer: Uma situação em que evidências objetivas indicam o não cumprimento de um requisito especificado pelo S.M.S.

CD0005 — ISM Code.question: De conformidad con el código IGS, ¿cuál es la definición de «incumplimiento»? Seleccione la ÚNICA respuesta correcta.
options: Una situación en la que las pruebas objetivas indican el incumplimiento de un requisito concreto especificado en el SMS
Una situación en la que un auditor piensa que no se ha cumplido un requisito del SMS
Una situación en la que el barco no llega a su destino a tiempo
Una situación en la que alguien sufre un accidente a bordo
CD0005 — ISM Code.answer: Una situación en la que las pruebas objetivas indican el incumplimiento de un requisito concreto especificado en el SMS

CD0005 — ISM Code.question: I.S.M. 강령에 따르면 "부적합"의 정의는 무엇입니까? 올바른 답을 하나 선택하십시오.
options: 객관적인 증거에 따라 S.M.S.에 명시된 특정 요건을 충족하지 못한 경우
감사자가 S.M.S. 요건이 충족되지 않았다고 생각하는 경우
제시간에 선박이 목적지에 도착하지 못한 경우
누군가 선상에서 사고를 당한 경우

CD0005 — ISM Code.question: Ai sensi del codice ISM, qual è la definizione di "non conformità"? Selezionare l'UNICA risposta esatta.
options: Una situazione in cui l'evidenza oggettiva indica il mancato adempimento di uno specifico requisito riportato dall'SMS
Una situazione in cui un ispettore ritiene che un requisito dell'SMS non sia soddisfatto
Una situazione in cui la nave non arriva a destinazione in tempo
Una situazione in cui si verifica un incidente a bordo
CD0005 — ISM Code.answer: Una situazione in cui l'evidenza oggettiva indica il mancato adempimento di uno specifico requisito riportato dall'SMS

CD0005 — ISM Code.question: Составной частью какой из конвенций ИМО является МКУБ? Выберите ОДИН правильный вариант ответа.

CD0005 — ISM Code.question: Hangi IMO anlaşması ISM Kodu'nun bir bölümüdür? BİR doğru cevap seçin.

STCW
MARPOL

CD0005 — ISM Code.question: Which IMO convention is the I.S.M. Code part of? Select the ONE correct answer.

STCW
MARPOL

CD0005 — ISM Code.answer: SOLAS

CD0005 — ISM Code.question: De quelle convention de l'OMI le Code ISM fait-il partie ? Sélectionnez LA réponse correcte.
options: SOLAS
STCW
MARPOL

CD0005 — ISM Code.answer: SOLAS

CD0005 — ISM Code.question: I.S.M. Code 属于以下哪个 IMO 公约？ 请选择一个正确答案。
options: SOLAS
STCW
MARPOL

A fine of $30,000 per visit
CD0006 — OPA 90.answer: The ship may be seized and sold

CD0006 — OPA 90.question: Which one of the following describes what action should be taken after an oil spill during bunkering in the USA has been cleaned up?
options: The effectiveness of the Vessel Response Plan should be reviewed
The next emergency response drill should cover bunker spills
The next spill emergency response drill need not be carried out
The chief engineer should be disciplined
CD0006 — OPA 90.answer: The effectiveness of the Vessel Response Plan should be reviewed

CD0006 — OPA 90.question: How does a ship’s OPA 90 Vessel Response Plan (VRP) affect its ability to discharge in a US terminal where it has never been before?
options: The ship can only operate in areas which are covered by its VRP
The ship can only load in new terminals, unless permission has been granted by the US Coast Guard
The ship can only discharge in new terminals if permission has been granted by the US Coast Guard
Ships can discharge non oil cargoes without restrictions, but not oil cargoes
CD0006 — OPA 90.answer: The ship can only operate in areas which are covered by its VRP

CD0006 — OPA 90.question: Ships over 300 GT which are trading to US ports need to have a COFR. What does COFR stand for?
options: Certificate of Financial Responsibility
Certificate of Final Rescue
Contract for Oil Fuel Responsibility
Contract for Oil Fuel Removal
CD0006 — OPA 90.answer: Certificate of Financial Responsibility

CD0006 — OPA 90.question: Which of the following was one of the important findings in the report into the Exxon Valdez accident?
options: Prevention is the first line of defence
Oil shipments from Alaskan ports should be banned
Oil tankers should be restricted in size
All oil tankers should be fitted with inert gas systems
CD0006 — OPA 90.answer: Prevention is the first line of defence

CD0006 — OPA 90.question: What is the longest period that an OPA 90 Vessel Response Plan can go before needing to be re-approved by the US Coast Guard?
options: 5 years
3 years
10 years
Until there is an important change made to it
CD0006 — OPA 90.answer: 5 years

CD0006 — OPA 90.question: How can an oil tanker sail in OPA 90 waters without an approved Vessel Response Plan (VRP)? Pick the answer you think is best.
options: It is on 'innocent passage'
It is only making one port call in the United States
It has been in service less than 3 months and its VRP has been submitted but not yet approved
It is only visiting an offshore oil terminal
CD0006 — OPA 90.answer: It is on 'innocent passage'

CD0006 — OPA 90.question: Which of the following best describes where the Oil Spill Liability Trust Fund gets its money since OPA 90 came into force?
options: From an oil shipment tax and from fines for oil pollution
From fines for oil pollution
From an oil shipment tax
From a tax on fuels for transportation
CD0006 — OPA 90.answer: From an oil shipment tax and from fines for oil pollution

CD0006 — OPA 90.question: Which of the following is the best way to find out your ship’s minimum stock of oil clean up materials for OPA 90 purposes?
options: Look in the ship’s Vessel Response Plan
Get a copy of OPA 90 from the internet
Get a copy of OPA 90 from the ship’s agent
Ask the Designated Person Ashore for a list
CD0006 — OPA 90.answer: Look in the ship’s Vessel Response Plan

CD0006 — OPA 90.question: Which of the following should be notified first of a probable oil spill from a ship in OPA 90 waters?
options: The National Response Center in Washington DC
Your Qualified Individual
Your Designated Person Ashore
The local harbourmaster
CD0006 — OPA 90.answer: The National Response Center in Washington DC

CD0006 — OPA 90.question: Which of the following best describes the main job of a Federal On Scene Coordinator during an oil spill in OPA 90 waters?
options: They will monitor your QI’s management of the clean up
They will control every aspect of the clean up
They will gather evidence for a prosecution
They will translate messages between the crew and the US Coast Guard
CD0006 — OPA 90.answer: They will monitor your QI’s management of the clean up

CD0006 — OPA 90.question: How often must the ship review an OPA 90 Vessel Response Plan?
options: At least once per year
Every 3 months
At least once every 5 years
When a change is required
CD0006 — OPA 90.answer: At least once per year

CD0006 — OPA 90.question: Which one of the following would you expect to contact your Oil Spill Response Organisation (OSRO) after your ship had an oil spill in OPA 90 waters?
options: Your Qualified Individual
The ship’s master
The Designated Person Ashore (DPA)
The US Coast Guard
CD0006 — OPA 90.answer: Your Qualified Individual

CD0006 — OPA 90.question: Which one of the following shipping accidents led to the introduction of the Oil Pollution Act of 1990 to the USA?
options: Exxon Valdez
Torrey Canyon
Erika
Prestige
CD0006 — OPA 90.answer: Exxon Valdez

CD0006 — OPA 90.question: Why can your OPA 90 Vessel Response Plan list several Salvage and Marine Fire Fighting service providers? Pick the answer you think is best.
options: Assistance must be provided within specified times so the providers must be near if there is an incident
The cheapest provider will be chosen when the incident happens
Each US State uses a different provider
US competition rules require that more than one provider be used
CD0006 — OPA 90.answer: Assistance must be provided within specified times so the providers must be near if there is an incident

CD0006 — OPA 90.question: How long must you keep records of OPA 90 training onboard?
options: 3 years
5 years
1 year
Until that crew member has gone on leave
CD0006 — OPA 90.answer: 3 years

CD0006 — OPA 90.question: Why, under OPA 90, can the nearest salvage tug capable of towing your ship be stationed further away than the nearest oil skimming machine? Pick the answer you think is best.
options: Small pollution discharges must be dealt with in shorter times than worst case discharges
The ship may be in water that is not deep enough for the tug
Salvage tugs of the right power are not always available in the US
An oil skimmer must be carried onboard each ship
CD0006 — OPA 90.answer: Small pollution discharges must be dealt with in shorter times than worst case discharges

CD0006 — OPA 90.question: Which one of the following could be the result of you being found ‘grossly negligent’ during an oil pollution incident within OPA 90 waters?
options: Your company could face unlimited liability, putting it out of business
You could be given a reward by the Department of Justice
Your maximum fine could be doubled
Your maximum prison sentence could be tripled
CD0006 — OPA 90.answer: Your company could face unlimited liability, putting it out of business

CD0006 — OPA 90.question: Why did the report into the Exxon Valdez recommend that OPA 90 require an effective response to oil pollution? Pick the answer you think is best.
options: It recognised that while oil is transported some spills are inevitable
It saw that there were no response plans before Exxon Valdez
It decided that insurance would not cover the costs of cleaning up spills
It recognised that there were not enough double hull tankers available to serve the US oil market
CD0006 — OPA 90.answer: It recognised that while oil is transported some spills are inevitable

CD0006 — OPA 90.question: If you carry out a remote assessment and consultation exercise while in OPA 90 waters how long should it take to get advice back from shore?
options: Less than 1 hour
Less than 3 hours
Less than 6 hours
Less than 15 minutes
CD0006 — OPA 90.answer: Less than 1 hour

CD0006 — OPA 90.question: Your Vessel Response Plan lists ‘COTP Zones’. What does COTP stand for?
options: Capacity Of The Pollution
Captain Of The Port
Clean up Of The Pollution
Central Operations for Transport Pollution
CD0006 — OPA 90.answer: Captain Of The Port

CD0006 — OPA 90.question: Which of the following best defines a Worst Case Discharge (WCD) for a ship?
options: Any oil discharge in adverse weather conditions
A discharge in adverse weather conditions of a vessel’s entire oil fuel and cargo
A discharge of heavy oil cargo
A discharge of a vessel’s entire oil cargo within a river
CD0006 — OPA 90.answer: A discharge in adverse weather conditions of a vessel’s entire oil fuel and cargo

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: Which of the statements given in the options best describes the SOLAS requirements for inert gas systems fitted to a gas carrier?
options: There must be two non-return devices fitted in the inert gas deck main.
There must be at least one non-return device fitted in the inert gas deck main.
At least one of the non-return devices fitted in the inert gas main must bo a water seal type.
Water seal type non-return devices are prohibited for use in the deck inert gas main on gas carriers
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: There must be two non-return devices fitted in the inert gas deck main.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: How is the humidity of the inert gas supply controlled for independent inert gas generator systems fitted to gas and chemical carriers?
options: By cooling and then drying the gas before the inlet to the deck main.
By having a dry type scrubber unit fitted.
By using coalescer filters in the fuel supply line.
By using a demister and coalescer filters at the scrubber outlet
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: By cooling and then drying the gas before the inlet to the deck main.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: Where in an independent inert gas generator system as fitted onboard a gas carrier would you expect to find a desiccant dryer unit?
options: As part of the humidity control system.
In the scrubber unit gas outlet.
In the deck water seal inlet.
In the combustion air intake
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: As part of the humidity control system.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: Which of the given options is the one that will most influence the combustion efficiency for the burner type described in this module?
options: Distance from the main burner tip to the edge of the air cone.
Distance from main burner tip to pilot burner tip
Distance from pilot burner tip to igniter.
Distance from pilot burner tip to edge of air cone.
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: Distance from the main burner tip to the edge of the air cone.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: What is the recommended interval for checking the calibration of an oxygen analyser as fitted to an independent inert gas generator system?
options: At least every eight hours when the system is in use.
At least every four hours when the system is in use.
Once every day when the system is in use.
Once a week as part of the planned maintenance schedule.
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: At least every eight hours when the system is in use.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: Which of the given statements best describes the operation of gas freeing when considering oil tankers fitted with inert gas systems?
options: The introduction of fresh air into a tank to remove all toxic, flammable and inert gases and increase the oxygen content to 21%.
The introduction of inert gas into a tank to remove all toxic and flammable gases to reduce the oxygen content to zero.
The introduction of oxygen into a tank to remove all toxic, flammable and inert gases to increase the oxygen content to 100%.
The introduction of nitrogen into a tank to remove all toxic, flammable and inert gases and reduce the oxygen content below 21%.
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: The introduction of fresh air into a tank to remove all toxic, flammable and inert gases and increase the oxygen content to 21%.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: There are a number of different types of inert gas system in use onboard oil tankers including the so called flue gas system. What does the term flue gas normally refer to in the context of inert gas systems?
options: Boiler exhaust gas
Diesel engine exhaust gas
Incinerator exhaust gas
Exhaust gas from an independent inert gas generator.
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: Boiler exhaust gas

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: One of the main reasons for the introduction of inert gas systems onboard oil tankers was the increase in the number of explosions onboard these vessels. Which one of the given options was found to be the main ignition source for these explosions?
options: Build up of static electricity during cargo and tank cleaning operations
Overheating of fuel oil bunker tanks adjacent to the cargo tanks
Crew members smoking on the cargo deck
The use of unsuitable electrical equipment on and around the cargo deck
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: Build up of static electricity during cargo and tank cleaning operations

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: Guidance regarding the IMO requirements for inert gas systems is given in the IMO publication Inert Gas Systems, 1990 edition. Which other publication from IMO gives general guidance relating to inert gas systems?
options: SOLAS
MARPOL
STCW
IMDG Code
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: SOLAS

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: Complete the following statement to give the IMO definition of an inert condition for a cargo tank. A condition in which the oxygen content throughout the atmosphere of a tank has been...........
options: reduced to 8% or less by volume by addition of inert gas
reduced to 20% or less by volume by addition of inert gas
reduced to 16% or less by volume by addition of inert gas
reduced to 0% by volume by addition of inert gas
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: reduced to 8% or less by volume by addition of inert gas

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: Which is the best test gas to use when checking and adjusting the zero setting of an oxygen analyser as fitted to an independent inert gas generator system?
options: Nitrogen
Carbon dioxide
Carbon monoxide
Hydrogen
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: Nitrogen

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: When considering an independent, oil fired inert gas generator what is the main purpose of the pilot burner?
options: It is used to provide an ignition source for the main burner.
It is used to preheat the furnace.
It is used to establish the correct oxygen content of the inert gas before the main burner starts.
It is used to preheat the combustion air to make it easier to ignite the main burner.
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: It is used to provide an ignition source for the main burner.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: When gas freeing a normally inerted cargo oil tank what should be the first step in the operation?
options: Purge with inert gas to bring the atmosphere to below the critical dilution line.
Purge with fresh air to bring the atmosphere to below the critical dilution line.
Purge with inert gas to bring the atmosphere to below the upper explosive limit.
Purge with fresh air to bring the atmosphere to below the lower explosive limit.
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: Purge with inert gas to bring the atmosphere to below the critical dilution line.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: Select the best option from those given to complete the following statement in relation to pressure vacuum breakers as fitted to the distribution system of some independent inert gas generator systems.^M^MThe correct operation of a liquid column type pressure vacuum breaker is dependent on .....
options: ....the correct specific gravity of the liquid and the liquid column height
....the correct operation of the mechanical non-return device in the deck main
....the correct operation of the automatic vent to atmosphere valve
....the correct operation of the deck water seal
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: ....the correct specific gravity of the liquid and the liquid column height

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: When considering an independent, oil fired inert gas generator how is the required flow of inert gas normally generated?
options: The combustion air fans provide sufficient pressure to ensure the necessary inert gas flow.
Additional booster fans are fitted in the deck main.
Cargo discharge rates are kept high to create a partial vacuum in the tanks which helps to draw in the inert gas.
Main inert gas fans are fitted after the scrubber unit to increase the flow of inert gas.
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: The combustion air fans provide sufficient pressure to ensure the necessary inert gas flow.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: When considering an independent, oil fired inert gas generator which incorporates a sea water scrubber unit. How is the water content of the inert gas normally kept to a minimum if the generator is used onboard an oil tanker?
options: A demister unit is fitted before the scrubber inert gas outlet.
The inert gas is passed through a series of coalescer filters after the scrubber unit.
The water flow through the scrubber unit is kept to a minimum.
The inert gas is passed through a refrigerated drying unit before it enters the deck water seal.
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: A demister unit is fitted before the scrubber inert gas outlet.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: When considering an independent, oil fired inert gas generator suitable for service onboard an oil tanker what is the SOLAS requirement regarding the composition of the tank atmosphere to be maintained?
options: A maximum of 8% oxygen content
A maximum of 5% oxygen content
A maximum of 1% oxygen content
A maximum of 11% oxygen content
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: A maximum of 8% oxygen content

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: What is generally taken as the minimum amount of oxygen in a mixture of atmospheric air and hydrocarbon gases that gives a safe margin against the risk of combustion?
What is the main risk associated with dilution of a normally inerted cargo oil tank atmosphere with fresh air?
options: During the process the atmosphere may be within the explosive range for some of the time.
During the process the atmosphere may become over rich for some of the time.
During the process the atmosphere may become too lean for some of the time.
During the process the oxygen content may exceed the maximum limit for a flammable mixture.
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: During the process the atmosphere may be within the explosive range for some of the time.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: A water column type pressure vacuum breaker device may be fitted to the deck main of an inert gas system. Which of the statements given in the options is true?
options: This type of device is usually designed to operate before the deck water seal reaches its limit.
This type of device is usually designed to operate only after the deck water seal fails.
This type of device is intended to protect individual tanks against over pressure or under vacuum.
This type of device is intended to protect individual tanks against over pressure or under vacuum.
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: This type of device is usually designed to operate before the deck water seal reaches its limit.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: What is the SOLAS requirement regarding non-return devices in the inert gas main for inert gas systems on oil tankers?
options: There must be at least two devices one of which should be a water seal type.
There must be at least two water seal type devices fitted.
There must be at least two neither of which should be a water seal type.
As long as there is a water seal no other devices are required
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: There must be at least two devices one of which should be a water seal type.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: During the operation of an independent inert gas generator, a problem develops with the scrubber unit effluent valves such that the water level in the scrubber unit reaches alarm condition. In addition to the alarm sounding what other action is most likely to result from this condition?
options: Immediate shut down of the inert gas generator system.
The scrubber pump would immediately stop but the generator would continue.
Only the main burner would shut down
The deck main valve would close and the automatic vent would open but the generator would continue operating.
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: Immediate shut down of the inert gas generator system.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: Which one of the alarm conditions given in the options would result in shutdown of the burner unit and the blower continuing to run for a cooling down period when considering the operation of an independent inert gas generator?
options: Scrubber pump low discharge pressure.
Deck inert gas main high pressure.
High oxygen content of inert gas
Combustion air blower low load
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: Scrubber pump low discharge pressure.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: When considering the water supply to the deck water seal for an inert gas system which of the following statements is true?
options: There should be at least one independent pump for continuously supplying water to the deck seal.
The water supply can be taken directly from the fire main.
A water supply to the deck seal is only required during cargo operations
The deck seal must be supplied directly from the engine room sea water main and auxiliary systems.
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: There should be at least one independent pump for continuously supplying water to the deck seal.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: How is the quantity of inert gas from an independent inert gas generator normally monitored?
options: By the pressure in the deck main.
By the oxygen content at the scrubber outlet.
By the blower electrical load.
By the temperature at the scrubber outlet.
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: By the pressure in the deck main.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: Considering an oil tanker fitted with an independent inert gas generator system. Which of the items identified in the options is most likely to be operating continuously when the cargo tanks are full of cargo?
options: Deck seal pump
Scrubber water pump
Combustion air blower
Capacity control valve
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: Deck seal pump

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: Which one of the given options is the most likely type of fixed gas measuring device to be fitted for monitoring and control of the quality of the inert gas produced by an independent inert gas generator?
options: A paramagnetic type oxygen analyser.
A heated filament combustible gas analyser.
A carbon monoxide monitor.
A carbon dioxide monitor.
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: A paramagnetic type oxygen analyser.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: Which of the given options describes the lower explosive limit in relation to the atmosphere of a cargo oil tank atmosphere?
options: The least proportion of hydrocarbon gases in a mixture with atmospheric air which is flammable.
The least proportion of oxygen in a mixture of hydrocarbon gases and atmospheric air which is flammable.
The lowest amount of oxygen which will support a flame when mixed with hydrocarbon gases.
The lowest point in a cargo tank ullage space where the mixture of hydrocarbon gases and air is flammable
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: The least proportion of hydrocarbon gases in a mixture with atmospheric air which is flammable.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: Considering the ullage space of a cargo tank containing petroleum based oil. Which of the given statements best describes the atmosphere of the ullage space?
options: It will contain a mixture of atmospheric air and hydrocarbon gases with an oxygen content of less than 21% by volume.
It will contain a mixture of atmospheric air and hydrocarbon gases with an oxygen content greater than 21% by volume.
It will contain a mixture of atmospheric air and hydrocarbon gases with an oxygen content equal to approximately 21% by volume.
It will contain a layer of hydrocarbon gases and a layer of atmospheric air since the two cannot mix.
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: It will contain a mixture of atmospheric air and hydrocarbon gases with an oxygen content of less than 21% by volume.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: Which of the given ranges of oxygen content by volume is likely to be achieved when supplying inert gas from an independent inert gas generator operating on distillate fuel?
options: Less than 0.5%

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: During start up sequence of an independent inert gas generator it is necessary to allow time for a pre-purge of the furnace whether in manual or automatic mode. What is the recommended minimum time for such a pre-purge operation?
options: 3 minutes
5 seconds
30 seconds
1 minute
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: 3 minutes

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: With reference to the adjustment of the set points for the process controllers and the alarm for an independent inert gas generator which one of the statements given in the options is the most accurate?
options: There is usually some in built security feature to limit access to these settings.
Any of the settings can be adjusted by anyone operating the generator
The settings are factory set and cannot normally be adjusted.
Normally only the alarm settings can be adjusted on this type of inert gas generator by ship’s staff.
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: There is usually some in built security feature to limit access to these settings.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: In the event that the oxygen content of the inert gas supply from an inert gas generator exceeded the value of the set point an alarm would sound. Which one of the given options is also the most likely to occur in such a situation?
options: The automatic vent valve would open and the deck main valve would close.
The generator would immediately shut down.
The main burner would shut down but the blower would continue to run.
The scrubber pump would automatically stop.
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: The automatic vent valve would open and the deck main valve would close.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: During loaded passage the inert gas pressure in the cargo tanks can vary due to changes in ambient temperature. Which of the given options would be the preferred way to maintain the correct pressure on a vessel fitted with an independent inert gas generator?
options: Intermittent operation of the generator in automatic mode to top up the pressure.
Continuous operation of the generator in automatic mode at a very low capacity setting using the automatic atmospheric vent to maintain the pressure.
Intermittent operation of the generator in manual mode to top up the pressure
Continuous operation of the generator in manual mode to maintain the pressure with manual control of the atmospheric vent valve.
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: Intermittent operation of the generator in automatic mode to top up the pressure.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: On which one of the vessel types given in the options would a nitrogen generator most likely to be fitted for the purpose of providing inert gas to the cargo system and associated spaces?
options: Chemical tanker
Crude oil carrier
Steam ship used as a heavy fuel oil carrier
Container vessel
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: Chemical tanker

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: Which of the given options represents the approximate percentage content by volume of nitrogen in atmospheric air?

While operating an independent inert gas generator during cargo discharge it is noted that the automatic vent valve is continuously 50% open. Which of the given options would be the best adjustment to make in order to minimise the gas being lost to atmosphere whilst maintaining the inert gas main pressure?
options: Reduce the system capacity control setting.
Increase the cargo discharge rate
Increase the set point setting for the deck pressure control.
Reduce the fuel pressure to the generator burner.
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: Reduce the system capacity control setting.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: SOLAS stipulates the maximum content of oxygen by volume that an inert gas system, including an independent inert gas generator type, must be capable of supplying. Which of the given options is this maximum value?
For an independent inert gas generator with automatic control which one of the parameters in the given options is most likely to have a controller set point that can be adjusted by the operator?
options: The pressure of the inert gas in the deck main.
The temperature of the scrubber effluent.
The pressure of the seawater to the deck seal.
The viscosity of the fuel to the burner unit.
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: The pressure of the inert gas in the deck main.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: High efficiency burners are often used in independent inert gas generators to ensure good combustion and that high quality inert gas is produced. Monitoring the gases from the combustion process can give an indication of the efficiency of the combustion. Which of the given options indicates good combustion?
options: Minimum carbon monoxide content
Minimum oxygen content
Minimum carbon dioxide content
Minimum nitrogen oxide content
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: Minimum carbon monoxide content

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: Which term is used to identify the operation whereby inert gas is introduced into a cargo tank in order to reduce the oxygen content throughout the atmosphere of the tank to 8% or less by volume?
options: Inerting.
Gas freeing
Purging
Topping up
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: Inerting.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: Which of the given options is the main reason for ensuring that the air cone of the burner unit for an independent inert gas generator is properly positioned and maintained?
options: If not it will result in poor combustion
If not it will result in a high oxygen content of the inert gas
If not it will result in a low carbon monoxide content of the inert gas
If not it will result in overpressure in the inert gas main
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: If not it will result in poor combustion

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: Some oil fired, independent inert gas generators incorporate capacity control to regulate the rate of delivery of the inert gas to the distribution system. Which of the given options is the primary element regulated by such a control feature?
options: The combustion air blower load.
The fuel pump pressure.
The fuel recirculation valve.
The fuel rate to the main burner.
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: The combustion air blower load.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: In the event of a multiple alarm condition occurring during operation of an independent inert gas generator what will be the normal arrangement for the alarm display?
options: All alarms will be listed in order of priority.
Only the last alarm to occur will be shown.
Only the most important alarm to occur will be shown.
All alarms will be listed in the order they occurred.
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: All alarms will be listed in order of priority.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: Which term is used to identify the operation whereby fresh air is introduced into a cargo tank in order to remove toxic, flammable and inert gases and to increase the oxygen content of the tank to 21% by volume?
options: Gas freeing
Diluting
Purging
Inerting
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: Gas freeing

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: Independent, oil fired, inert gas generators are usually operated on distillate fuel rather than residual fuel. What is the main reason for this?
options: Operating on distillate fuel normally produces a cleaner exhaust gas with a lower oxygen content due to relatively good combustion.
The inert gas plant does not require a scrubber unit since distillate fuels are have a zero sulphur content.
More exhaust gas is available when burning distillate fuel.
Distillate fuel is more readily available than residual fuel
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: Operating on distillate fuel normally produces a cleaner exhaust gas with a lower oxygen content due to relatively good combustion.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: When considering the automatic operation of an independent inert gas generator the start up sequence normally has delays built in to ensure correct timing of the sequence. For example there will be a delay in the sequence to ensure sufficient furnace purging time. How can these delays be ensured in manual mode?
options: By the use of timed interlocks which operate even in the manual mode.
The operator is relied upon to ensure the correct timing of the sequence.
The delays are only an extra safety precaution so it doesn’t matter if they missed out.
There is no need for any delays if the operator is in attendance during start up.
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: By the use of timed interlocks which operate even in the manual mode.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: The combustion air blowers of an inert gas generator may be used to supply fresh air during venting and gas freeing operations following purging of cargo tanks and lines. What precautions must be taken when carrying out such operations with an independent inert gas generator?
options: Ensure all none purged tanks are properly isolated from the inert gas main.
Ensure the atmospheric vent valve is fully opened.
Ensure that the capacity control setting is at a minimum
Ensure that the inert gas generator fuel pump is running on recirculation throughout the operation.
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: Ensure all none purged tanks are properly isolated from the inert gas main.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: Independent inert gas generator systems fitted to gas carriers often have refrigerated type cooler dryer units fitted to control the humidity of the inert gas. Which condition of the gas is used to control entry of the gas into the drier section of such a unit?
options: The temperature of the inert gas
The humidity of the inert gas
The pressure of the inert gas
The oxygen content of the inert gas
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: The temperature of the inert gas

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: What is the main reason for controlling the humidity of the inert gas produced by an independent inert gas generator when fitted to a gas or chemical tanker?
options: To avoid compatibility problems with the cargo.
To avoid corrosion problems in the cargo pipelines.
To avoid corrosion problems in the inert gas deck main.
To avoid contamination of the deck seal water.
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: To avoid compatibility problems with the cargo.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: An independent inert gas generator is supplying the inert gas during cargo discharge operations when the low low pressure alarm sounds. Which one of the given options is most likely to automatically happen when such a condition develops?
options: Automatic shut down of the cargo pumps.
Deck main valve closes and automatic vent opens.
Automatic shut down of inert gas generator.
Pressure vacuum breaker operates on deck..
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: Automatic shut down of the cargo pumps.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: For the independent inert gas generator considered in this module how is the primary control of the deck main pressure at its set point achieved?
options: By the automatic operation of the atmospheric vent valve.
By varying the blower load.
By varying the fuel pressure to the main burner.
By automatic adjustment of the capacity control valve.
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: By the automatic operation of the atmospheric vent valve.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: For the independent inert gas generator considered in this module how is the oxygen content of the inert gas automatically controlled?
options: By adjustment of the fuel capacity control setting.
By adjustment of the blower capacity setting.
By adjustment of the automatic atmospheric vent valve.
By adjustment of the automatic deck main valve.
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: By adjustment of the fuel capacity control setting.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: In the event of an alarm condition occurring during operation of an independent inert gas generator how will the operator know which parameter is in alarm condition? Select the most common method from the options given.
options: The audible alarm will sound and the alarm status screen will automatically display.
The audible alarm will sound and the operator can then select the alarm status screen.
The audible alarm will sound and the operator will need to check the local readings to identify the cause.
The audible alarm will sound and the alarm will be indicated on the bridge which will then inform the operator.
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: The audible alarm will sound and the alarm status screen will automatically display.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: For an independent inert gas generator with automatic control which one of the parameters in the given options is most likely to have a set point that can be adjusted by the operator?
options: The oxygen content of the inert gas.
The temperature of the inert gas at the scrubber outlet.
The temperature of the fuel at the burner inlet.
The rate of water flow to the deck seal.
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: The oxygen content of the inert gas.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: Which parameter is normally used as the main indicator of the quality of inert gas supply for the cargo system of an oil tanker?
options: Oxygen content.
Humidity.
Temperature.
Pressure.
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: Oxygen content.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: When considering an independent, oil fired inert gas generator suitable for service onboard an oil tanker what are the SOLAS requirements for the oxygen content of the inert gas supply?
options: A maximum of 5%.
A maximum of 8%.
A maximum of 11%.
A maximum of 3%.
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: A maximum of 5%.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: Which one of the statements given in the options is the most accurate in respect of control of oil fired, independent inert gas generators?
options: The generators are usually automatically controlled but normally also have a manual control facility.
The generators are normally started in the manual mode but can be changed to automatic mode once inert gas production has started.
There is normally only one control station for the generator which is situated locally to the generator.
If a second control station for this type of inert gas generator is provided it is normally situated on the bridge.
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: The generators are usually automatically controlled but normally also have a manual control facility.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: Where a liquid column type pressure vacuum breaker device is fitted to the deck main of an inert gas system which liquid is normally used to fill the device?
options: A water glycol mix.
Fresh water.
Seawater.
Diesel oil.
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: A water glycol mix.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: When considering an independent, oil fired inert gas generator, other than providing a vent to the atmosphere during start up of the plant, what is the other main purpose of the automatic atmospheric vent valve?
options: It is used in conjunction with the inert gas main valve to regulate the pressure in the inert gas main.
It acts as an inlet for fresh air to the system when gas freeing.
It acts as the main relief device in the event of overpressure.
It is used to control the capacity of the inert gas generator.
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: It is used in conjunction with the inert gas main valve to regulate the pressure in the inert gas main.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: Which one of the vessel types given in the options is most likely to be fitted with an independent inert gas generator?
options: A motor ship designed to carry petroleum product cargoes.
A steam ship designed to carry crude oil cargoes.
A motor ship designed to carry high grade lubricating oil cargoes.
A steam ship designed to carry high grade chemical cargoes.
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: A motor ship designed to carry petroleum product cargoes.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: When considering an independent, oil fired inert gas generator how is the furnace usually prevented from overheating?
options: By surrounding the furnace with a water jacket.
By providing a large flow of excess air to the combustion chamber.
By making the walls of the combustion chamber extra thick.
By intermittent firing of the burner.
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: By surrounding the furnace with a water jacket.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: When considering an independent, oil fired inert gas generator how is it normally protected in the event of a flame failure of the main burner?
options: It will normally result in audible and visual alarms and an automatic shut down of the generator.
It will normally result in automatic ignition of the pilot burner.
The generator will automatically purge the furnace and restart.
There will be an alarm to alert the operator to manually shut down the system.
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: It will normally result in audible and visual alarms and an automatic shut down of the generator.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: What effect on the upper and lower flammable limits does the introduction of inert gas into a cargo oil tank have?
options: It reduces the upper flammable limit and increases the lower flammable limit.
It reduces the lower flammable limit and increases the upper flammable limit
It reduces both the upper flammable limit and the lower flammable limit
It increses both the upper flammable limit and the lower flammable limit
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: It reduces the upper flammable limit and increases the lower flammable limit.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: What is the percentage content by volume of oxygen in atmospheric air generally taken to be?
Which of the given options describes the upper explosive limit in relation to the atmosphere of a cargo oil tank atmosphere?
options: The highest proportion of hydrocarbon gases in a mixture with atmospheric air which is flammable.
The highest proportion of oxygen in a mixture of hydrocarbon gases and atmospheric air which is flammable.
The greatest amount of oxygen which will support a flame when mixed with hydrocarbon gases.
The highest point in a cargo tank ullage space where the mixture of hydrocarbon gases and air is flammable.
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: The highest proportion of hydrocarbon gases in a mixture with atmospheric air which is flammable.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: What is the approximate minimum amount of oxygen in a mixture of atmospheric air and hydrocarbon gases that will support combustion?
In auto start mode which of the given options will start first when starting up an independent inert gas generator? Assume all normal pre-start requirements have been met.
options: Scrubber pump
Combustion air blower
Fuel pump
Igniter
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: Scrubber pump

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: During the start up procedure for an independent inert gas generator when should the inert gas deck main valve be opened?
options: Once the measured oxygen content reaches the set point value.
Once the main burner is operating.
Once the combustion air blower is operating.
Once the deck seal pump is operating.
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: Once the measured oxygen content reaches the set point value.

CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.question: Which of the control touch screens considered in this module will allow the operator single button control of the start up of the inert gas system if all pre-start conditions are met?
options: Auto-start screen
Main screen
Manual start screen
Alarm status screen
CD0007 — Inert Gas Generator.answer: Auto-start screen

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: Which one of the oxygen levels given in the options is the minimum level for the oxygen content in the output from a flue gas plant that you should take action to investigate why the oxygen content is not lower?
Which one of the following would you expect to happen if the blower on a flue gas plant tripped out on overload?
options: The inert gas system will shutdown
The other blower will start automatically
The boiler will be tripped
The blower’s inlet and outlet valves will automatically close
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: The inert gas system will shutdown

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: What is the recommended period for opening up the non return valve on deck for internal inspection?
options: Once a year
Every week
After use
During every ballast voyage
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: Once a year

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: Which one of the following is a check that should be carried out on a P/V valve fitted to an inert gas deck main?
options: Check liquid level when system is at atmospheric pressure
Check liquid level when system is running at full capacity
Lubricate all linkages
Open and close the valve every week
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: Check liquid level when system is at atmospheric pressure

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: Which of the following best describes the most likely cause of low deck main pressure while a flue gas type inert gas plant is running?
options: Cargo discharge rate in excess of the blower output
Low boiler load
P/V valve seized shut
Deck seal empty
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: Cargo discharge rate in excess of the blower output

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: Which one of the following is likely to happen if the oxygen content of the inert gas being supplied to the cargo spaces of an oil tanker rises above 8 percent and the ‘high-high’ oxygen alarm sounds?
options: The gas regulating valve will automatically close, and the vent or recirculation valve will open
The inert gas blowers will stop and the plant is shut down
The gas regulating valve and the boiler uptake valves will automatically close
The boiler burners will shut down
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: The gas regulating valve will automatically close, and the vent or recirculation valve will open

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: Which one of the following would be the best gas to use to zero the fixed oxygen analyser monitoring an inert gas plant?
options: Nitrogen
Methane
Butane
50/50 Methane/Butane mix
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: Nitrogen

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: Which of the following best describes the most likely initial consequence of low boiler load when a flue gas type inert gas plant is running?
options: A high oxygen level
A low deck main pressure
Increased inert gas recirculation
High gas temperature at the blower outlet
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: A high oxygen level

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: When an oil tanker has a flue gas type inert gas plant which is also used for gas freeing of cargo tanks where is the air normally drawn from?
options: The blower fresh air inlet
The flue of a shut down boiler
The deck seal vent
A gas free tank
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: The blower fresh air inlet

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: Which of the following operations is carried out last when shutting down a typical flue gas plant?
options: Shut down the scrubber water pump
Open the ventilation valve to atmosphere
Close the gas regulating valve
Close the boiler uptake valve
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: Shut down the scrubber water pump

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: What is the purpose of the deck water seal fitted to an oil tanker’s inert gas system?
options: To prevent backflow of hazardous vapours into the gas safe areas
To cool the inert gas before it enters the cargo tanks
To clean the inert gas before it enters the cargo tanks
To prevent inert gas entering the tanks during loading operations
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: To prevent backflow of hazardous vapours into the gas safe areas

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: According to the instructions in this module, which of these options would be carried out first when starting up a flue gas plant?
options: Open the boiler uptake valve
Start the blower
Open the blower discharge valve
Open the gas regulating valve
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: Open the boiler uptake valve

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: According to the Fire Safety Systems Code what is the maximum oxygen content permitted in the cargo tanks of an oil tanker?
options: 8% by volume
3% by volume
11% by volume
21% by volume
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: 8% by volume

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: In an oil cargo tank in which there is a mixture of hydrocarbon gas and air, which of the following is the best definition of the “Lower flammable limit” (LFL)?
options: It is the concentration of hydrocarbon vapour below which there is insufficient gas in the mixture to support combustion
It is the point where the oxygen content becomes too high to support combustion
It is the point where the concentration of inert gas becomes too low to prevent combustion
It is the point where the concentration of inert gas becomes too high to support combustion
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: It is the concentration of hydrocarbon vapour below which there is insufficient gas in the mixture to support combustion

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: When the inert gas plant on an oil tanker suffers an automatic shutdown which one of the options below is true of the seawater pumps and blowers?
options: Only the seawater pumps are left running
All pumps and blowers are shut down
All pumps and blowers are left running
All pumps and blowers are left running, the boiler uptake valve shuts the gas off
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: Only the seawater pumps are left running

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: What is the Fire Safety Systems Code requirement regarding non return devices in the inert gas main for inert gas systems on oil tankers?
options: There must be at least two devices one of which should be a water seal type
There must be at least two water seal type devices fitted
There must be at least two neither of which should be a water seal type
As long as there is a water seal no other devices are required
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: There must be at least two devices one of which should be a water seal type

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: Which of the following is the best explanation of the purpose of the scrubber unit in a flue gas type inert gas plant?
options: To cool the gas while removing soot particles and sulphur dioxide
To prevent flue gas entering the plant while it is shut down
To cool the gas
To remove moisture from the flue gas before being sent to the tanks
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: To cool the gas while removing soot particles and sulphur dioxide

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: In an oil cargo tank in which there is a mixture of hydrocarbon gas and air, which of the following is the best definition of the ”upper flammable limit” (UFL)?
options: It is the concentration of hydrocarbon gas above which there is insufficient oxygen to support and propagate combustion
It is the point where the oxygen content becomes too high to support combustion
It is the point where the concentration of inert gas becomes high enough to prevent combustion
It is the concentration of a hydrocarbon gas which is just enough to support combustion
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: It is the concentration of hydrocarbon gas above which there is insufficient oxygen to support and propagate combustion

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: What is the purpose of the pressure/vacuum breaker fitted to an oil tanker’s inert gas system?
options: To relieve excess pressure or vacuum in the inert gas main
To control the pressure of inert gas supplied to the cargo tanks
To improve cargo pump performance in case the inert gas blower cannot keep up with the cargo discharge rate
To prevent backflow of cargo vapours into the inert gas scrubber
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: To relieve excess pressure or vacuum in the inert gas main

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: When opened up the scrubber unit of a flue gas type inert gas plant is found to contain a mattress of polypropylene mesh. Which of the following is the best explanation for this mesh being there?
options: It is fitted to the scrubber to dry the gas
It has fallen from the blower inlet into the scrubber
The lining of the scrubber has come off
It acts as a wet filter inside the scrubber
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: It is fitted to the scrubber to dry the gas

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: Which of the following is the typical oxygen level in the exhaust gas that can be achieved from good combustion in a ship’s boiler?
options: 4 to 5%
7 to 8%
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: 4 to 5%

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: Which one of the following would you expect to happen on an oil tanker if the pressure in the inert gas main falls to about 50 mm Water Gauge during cargo discharge operations?
options: The cargo pumps shutdown automatically
The inert gas recirculating valve automatically opens fully
The inert gas blowers shutdown automatically
The P/V valve will open fully
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: The cargo pumps shutdown automatically

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: In relation to oil tanker cargo spaces which one of the following is the best definition of the expression “purging”?
options: To blow inert gas into a tank to reduce the oxygen or hydrocarbon gas level
To replace the inert gas in a tank with fresh air
To replace the inert gas in a cargo tank with hydrocarbon gas
To replace the inert gas in a cargo tank with oil cargo or ballast
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: To blow inert gas into a tank to reduce the oxygen or hydrocarbon gas level

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: In which one of the following IMO publications would you find the requirements for the design of a new inert gas system?
options: International Code for Fire Safety Systems (FSS Code)
MARPOL Annex I
SOLAS Chapter IV
ISM Code
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: International Code for Fire Safety Systems (FSS Code)

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: Which one of the following is the minimum required capacity of the blowers fitted to an oil tanker’s inert gas plant, as a proportion of the ship’s maximum cargo discharge rate?
options: 125% in total
100% in total
110% in total
100% per blower
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: 125% in total

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: In some types of inert gas plants using flue gas, air is supplied to the boiler uptake valves. What is the reason for this?
options: To ensure no flue gas leaks pass the uptake valves when the plant is shut down
To prevent condensation in the inert gas plant when it is shut down
To cool the scrubber tower when the plant is shut down
To prevent inert gas passing into the boiler uptake when the plant is running
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: To ensure no flue gas leaks pass the uptake valves when the plant is shut down

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: What is the main risk associated with dilution of a normally inerted cargo oil tank atmosphere with fresh air?
options: During the process the atmosphere may be within the flammable range for some of the time
During the process the atmosphere may become over rich for some of the time
During the process the atmosphere may become too lean for some of the time
During the process the oxygen content may exceed the maximum limit for a flammable mixture
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: During the process the atmosphere may be within the flammable range for some of the time

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: On some inert gas plants using flue gas the speed of the blowers is variable.  Which of the following is the best explanation for fitting variable speed blowers?
options: The pressure of the gas delivered to deck can be controlled
The speed can be reduced during blower washing
The speed can be varied to prevent bearing damage
The electrical power used by the blowers can be reduced
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: The pressure of the gas delivered to deck can be controlled

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: According to the Fire Safety Systems Code which one of the following would be considered a safe amount of oxygen in the output from an inert gas plant?
options: Less than 5% oxygen
Less than 16 % oxygen
Less than 11 % oxygen
Less than 21% oxygen
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: Less than 5% oxygen

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: Many oil tankers are fitted with an inert gas system supplying their cargo tanks. What is the main purpose of introducing inert gas into a cargo tank?
options: To create a non-explosive atmosphere in the tank
To make the tank safe for entry
To reduce the generation of static electricity in the tank
To prevent evaporation of the cargo
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: To create a non-explosive atmosphere in the tank

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: Some oil tankers are fitted with one large inert gas blower and one smaller blower.  Which of the following is the best explanation for fitting a small blower?
options: It can be used when topping up the gas pressure at sea
It keeps electrical loads lower during discharges
The total blower capacity can be reduced
It is for use when gas freeing
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: It can be used when topping up the gas pressure at sea

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: Which term is used to identify the operation whereby inert gas is introduced into a cargo tank in order to reduce the oxygen content throughout the atmosphere of the tank to 8% or less by volume?
options: Inerting
Gas freeing
Purging
Topping up
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: Inerting

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: On an oil tanker how long must the deck water seal supply be left on after the inert gas system is shut down?
options: It must be left running continuously to maintain an adequate seal
It is left running for two hours after shut down of the inert gas plant
It is left running for 30 minutes after the inert gas plant is shut down
It can be stopped as soon as the inert gas plant has been shut down
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: It must be left running continuously to maintain an adequate seal

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: Which of the following best describes the action to be taken by the watchkeeper as soon as the blower in a flue gas type inert gas plant is stopped during shut down of the plant?
options: The blower washing water should be turned on
The blower washing water should be turned off
The scrubber water should be turned off
The blower drains should be shut
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: The blower washing water should be turned on

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: Which of the following is the main purpose of filling the free space above the oil cargo onboard a tanker with inert gas?
options: To keep the tank atmosphere outside the flammable range
To reduce evaporation of the cargo
To cool the tank
To prevent contamination of the cargo
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: To keep the tank atmosphere outside the flammable range

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: Which one of the following is a maintenance problem that can be seen during an external examination of the blower of an inert gas plant?
options: Cracking
Soot build up
Impeller corrosion
Epoxy coating damage
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: Cracking

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: Which one of the following is the generally agreed reason for the rise in explosions experienced in the 1960s and 1970s, as oil tankers became larger?
options: Static electricity
Low sulphur crude
High sulphur crude
High voltage electrical systems
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: Static electricity

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: The power supply to a flue gas type inert gas plant is normally left on, even when the plant is shut down. Which of the following best describes the reason for this?
options: Some alarm functions must be operational even when the plant is not
The blowers will automatically be turned every 6 hours
The oxygen level must be continuously monitored
The oxygen level must be continuously monitored
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: Some alarm functions must be operational even when the plant is not

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: If the inert gas at the blower outlet gets too hot a high temperature alarm is given. What will happen if the temperature of the gas continues to rise?
options: The inert gas blowers will stop and the gas regulating valve closes
The inert gas will be vented to air until the temperature drops
The backup scrubber water pump will be started automatically
The temperature of the inert gas in the cargo tanks should be monitored every 15 minutes
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: The inert gas blowers will stop and the gas regulating valve closes

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: When entering any part of the inert gas system to carry out maintenance or inspections, which of the following is the main danger to personnel?
options: Oxygen deficiency
Gas flammability
Acidic attack
Bacterial infection
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: Oxygen deficiency

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: Which of the following is the best definition for ‘inert gas’, as used to protect the cargo spaces of oil tankers?
options: It is a gas containing insufficient oxygen to support the combustion of hydrocarbons
It is a gas containing no oxygen
It is any gas containing less than 21 % by volume of oxygen
It is a gas containing too much hydrocarbon vapour to support combustion
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: It is a gas containing insufficient oxygen to support the combustion of hydrocarbons

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: On inert gas plants when the scrubber water flow drops below a certain rate an alarm is given. What will happen if the flow rate drops further?
options: The inert gas blowers will stop and the gas regulating valve closes
The pressure control system will reduce the plant output
The boiler uptake valve will close
The deck seal sea water pump will automatically switch to supply the scrubber
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: The inert gas blowers will stop and the gas regulating valve closes

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: Which of the following best describes the reason for the fixed oxygen meter being fitted close to its sampling point?
options: To reduce the time between the sample being taken and analysed
To protect it from heat
The oxygen level rises as it passes along the sample line
The oxygen level falls as it passes along the sample line
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: To reduce the time between the sample being taken and analysed

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: Which of the following best describes the most likely cause of the boiler soot blowers failing to work while a flue gas type inert gas plant is running?
options: The interlock is operating to prevent excessive soot entering the inert gas
The exhaust gas pressure will be too low for effective soot blowing
The cargo pump turbines will reduce steam pressure too far
The exhaust gas is diverted away from the tubes during inert gas production
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: The interlock is operating to prevent excessive soot entering the inert gas

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: Which of the following is the location that the gas regulating valve is required to be fitted to in inert gas systems on oil tankers?
options: The bulkhead where the inert gas main passes from the gas safe area into the cargo area
In the inert gas main forward of the deck seal
Between the deck seal and the P/V valve
At each of the blower outlets
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: The bulkhead where the inert gas main passes from the gas safe area into the cargo area

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: Which one of the following automatically prevents excessive overpressure or vacuum in the inert gas main?
options: P/V Breaker
Vent to atmosphere valve
Inert gas blower discharge valve
Boiler uptake valve
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: P/V Breaker

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: Select the best option from those given to complete the following statement in relation to protection against excessive vacuum as fitted to the inert gas deck main.^M^MThe correct operation of the pressure/vacuum breaker is dependent on .....
options: ..the correct specific gravity of the liquid and the liquid column height
..the correct operation of the mechanical non-return device in the deck main
..the correct operation of the automatic vent to atmosphere valve
..the correct operation of the deck water seal
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: ..the correct specific gravity of the liquid and the liquid column height

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: These below diagrams represent different types of deck seal. Which one is the wet type deck seal?
options: A
B
C
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: A

CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.question: When working inside parts of the inert gas system such as the scrubber or deck water seal, which procedure must be followed?
options: Enclosed space entry
Working aloft
Working with self contained breathing apparatus (SCBA)
Electrical work permit
CD0008 — Flue Gas Plant.answer: Enclosed space entry
