CD0018 — Cooling Systems.answer: To convert the high velocity kinetic energy of the fluid to pressure energy.

CD0018 — Cooling Systems.question: Why would a U tube manometer normally be fitted to a diesel engine charge air cooler?
options: To measure the pressure drop across the cooler.
To measure the atmospheric pressure in the engine room.
To measure the pressure in the scavenge air manifold.
To measure the output pressure of the turbocharger.
CD0018 — Cooling Systems.answer: To measure the pressure drop across the cooler.

CD0018 — Cooling Systems.question: When would a split range control system normally be used in a diesel engine cooling system?
options: When both heating and cooling of the system are required.
When two jacket water coolers are fitted.
When the system is used for two engines.
When the system is used for main and auxiliary engines.
CD0018 — Cooling Systems.answer: When both heating and cooling of the system are required.

CD0018 — Cooling Systems.question: Why is seawater rarely used as the primary coolant for a diesel engine jacket water system?
options: There is a high risk of fouling and corrosion.
It is too cold.
It may cause cracks in the components.
It has a very low specific heat capacity.
CD0018 — Cooling Systems.answer: There is a high risk of fouling and corrosion.

CD0018 — Cooling Systems.question: What is the approximate value for the specific heat capacity of freshwater?
options: 4.2 kJ/kgK
42 kJ/kgK
420 kJ/kgK
1 kg/m³
CD0018 — Cooling Systems.answer: 4.2 kJ/kgK

CD0018 — Cooling Systems.question: At which point in a diesel engine jacket cooling water system is the temperature normally measured for temperature control purposes?
options: At the engine outlet.
At the outlet from the heat exchanger.
At the header tank.
At the engine inlet.
CD0018 — Cooling Systems.answer: At the engine outlet.

CD0018 — Cooling Systems.question: How is the temperature of the LT circuit controlled in a central cooling system?
options: By using a 3 way diverter valve to direct flow through the central coolers.
By using a 3 way mixing valve to mix water from the HT and LT circuit.
By using a 3 way mixing valve to mix water from the LT circuit with seawater.
By using a 3 way diverter valve to recirculate the seawater.
CD0018 — Cooling Systems.answer: By using a 3 way diverter valve to direct flow through the central coolers.

CD0018 — Cooling Systems.question: How is expansion of the tube stack accommodated for in a shell and tube type heat exchanger?
options: Only one tube plate is clamped, the other is free to move longitudinally in the shell.
The tubes are loosely fitted in the tube plate.
The heat exchanger is only fixed at one end.
Non expanding materials are used for the tubes.
CD0018 — Cooling Systems.answer: Only one tube plate is clamped, the other is free to move longitudinally in the shell.

CD0018 — Cooling Systems.question: Central cooling systems are widely used onboard modern ships. What is the main reason for using such a system?
options: To minimize the amount of seawater pipework required.
To minimize the number of heat exchangers required.
To have the equipment in the middle of the engineroom to minimize damage in the event of collision.
To allow all of the pipes to be the same length.
CD0018 — Cooling Systems.answer: To minimize the amount of seawater pipework required.

CD0018 — Cooling Systems.question: Many shell and tube heat exchangers are described as multi-pass types where one of the fluids passes through the heat exchanger a number of times between entry and final exit. How are these multi-passes created?
options: By suitable division of the end covers.
By using a number of tube stacks.
By using diverter valves
By using recirculation valves
CD0018 — Cooling Systems.answer: By suitable division of the end covers.

CD0018 — Cooling Systems.question: Direct air cooling is used for some diesel engines. Which of the following duties are likely to have diesel engines which are directly air cooled?
options: Emergency electrical generator.
Medium speed main propulsion.
Main electrical generator.
Slow speed main propulsion.
CD0018 — Cooling Systems.answer: Emergency electrical generator.

CD0018 — Cooling Systems.question: When describing heat exchangers what does the term parallel flow mean?
options: Both fluids flow in the same direction through the heat exchanger.
Both fluids have vertical flow paths.
Both fluids have horizontal flow paths.
Both fluids flow through the tubes.
CD0018 — Cooling Systems.answer: Both fluids flow in the same direction through the heat exchanger.

CD0018 — Cooling Systems.question: Differential pressure cells are often fitted to diesel engine jacket cooling water systems. What is the main purpose for fitting them in such a system?
options: To monitor flow rate in the system.
To measure pressure drop across filters.
To measure pressure rise across the circulating pump.
To measure the level in the header tank.
CD0018 — Cooling Systems.answer: To monitor flow rate in the system.

CD0018 — Cooling Systems.question: Cavitation erosion leading to corrosion can be a problem with some diesel engine components. Which one of the following are the most likely to suffer this form of damage?
options: Water side of cylinder liners.
Combustion side of cylinder liners.
Piston crowns.
Exhaust valves.
CD0018 — Cooling Systems.answer: Water side of cylinder liners.

CD0018 — Cooling Systems.question: Where would you find detailed information relating to health and safety and environmental hazards associated with cooling water system treatment chemicals?
options: From the material safety data sheets.
On the packaging or container for the treatment.
In the engine manual.
From the delivery note.
CD0018 — Cooling Systems.answer: From the material safety data sheets.

CD0018 — Cooling Systems.question: Why is silicate usually added to nitrite – borate based cooling water treatment?
options: To protect aluminium components in the system.
To protect against microbial problems.
To protect steel and iron components in the system
To protect the pump seals.
CD0018 — Cooling Systems.answer: To protect aluminium components in the system.

CD0018 — Cooling Systems.question: What form of treatment is a seawater cooling system normally treated with to avoid fouling by marine growth?
options: Electrochlorination
Nitrite – borate based corrosion inhibitors
Chromate based inhibitors
Zinc anodes
CD0018 — Cooling Systems.answer: Electrochlorination

CD0018 — Cooling Systems.question: Which of the options given describes the desired water quality for a diesel engine cooling water system?
options: Slightly alkaline with a low level of total dissolved solids.
Slightly acidic with a low level of total dissolved solids.
Slightly alkaline with a high level of total dissolved solids.
Slightly acidic with a high level of total dissolved solids.
CD0018 — Cooling Systems.answer: Slightly alkaline with a low level of total dissolved solids.

CD0018 — Cooling Systems.question: Chromate based corrosion inhibitors are not allowed as the cooling water treatment in some situations. In which of the following must alternatives be used?
options: When the system includes a fresh water generator for producing potable water.
When the system includes a fresh water generator for producing boiler feed water.
When the system doesn’t include a fresh water generator.
In a central cooling system.
CD0018 — Cooling Systems.answer: When the system includes a fresh water generator for producing potable water.

CD0018 — Cooling Systems.question: Which of the following values would be a typical value for the specific heat capacity of a mineral oil?
options: 2.0 kJ/kgK
2.0 kJ
4.2 kJ/kgK
4.0 kJ
CD0018 — Cooling Systems.answer: 2.0 kJ/kgK

CD0018 — Cooling Systems.question: Choose from the options given the one which correctly completes the following statement. Diesel engines need to be cooled in order to………. .
options: maintain component clearances and material properties.
maximise engine efficiency.
minimise soot deposits.
minimise scale formation.
CD0018 — Cooling Systems.answer: maintain component clearances and material properties.

CD0018 — Cooling Systems.question: Which of the following options is the reason for diesel engine components heating up during normal operation?
options: Heat released during combustion and generated by friction.
Heat transferred from the jacket cooling water.
Heat transferred from the circulation of lubricating oil.
Heat transferred from the engine room.
CD0018 — Cooling Systems.answer: Heat released during combustion and generated by friction.

CD0018 — Cooling Systems.question: The use of air cooling for large engines is normally limited due to which of the following.
options: Low specific heat capacity and density.
High potential to form scale on the heat transfer surfaces.
High cost.
Limited availability.
CD0018 — Cooling Systems.answer: Low specific heat capacity and density.

CD0018 — Cooling Systems.question: How is the temperature of the HT circuit water controlled in a central cooling system?
options: By mixing with water from the LT circuit using a 3 way temperature control valve.
By mixing with water from the seawater circuit using a 3 way temperature control valve.
By passing it through the central coolers.
By adding cold freshwater to the system header tank.
CD0018 — Cooling Systems.answer: By mixing with water from the LT circuit using a 3 way temperature control valve.

CD0018 — Cooling Systems.question: Which of the options given best describes a central cooling system?
options: A system that provides the cooling requirements for all of the ship’s machinery.
A system situated in the middle of the engine room.
A system which meets the ship’s machinery cooling requirement without using sea water.
A system which meets the ship’s machinery cooling requirements using only sea water.
CD0018 — Cooling Systems.answer: A system that provides the cooling requirements for all of the ship’s machinery.

CD0018 — Cooling Systems.question: What is the main reason for using central cooling systems onboard the ship?
options: To minimise the amount of seawater pipework and so minimise maintenance requirements.
To avoid the need for seawater pipework.
To allow plate heat exchangers to be used.
To allow the fresh water generator to be heated.
CD0018 — Cooling Systems.answer: To minimise the amount of seawater pipework and so minimise maintenance requirements.

CD0018 — Cooling Systems.question: What would be a typical temperature for the LT circuit to be controlled at in a central cooling system?

Temperature differentials can be used to help diagnose operating problems with heat exchangers. For a jacket water cooler, using seawater as the secondary coolant, which fault is indicated when the seawater temperature differential is reduced and the jacket water outlet temperature higher than usual, but all other parameters are normal.
options: Scale deposits on the seawater side of the tubes.
Tube blockage.
Jacket water leakage into the seawater side.
Reduced seawater flow.
CD0018 — Cooling Systems.answer: Scale deposits on the seawater side of the tubes.

CD0018 — Cooling Systems.question: When would it be most likely that split range control would be used in a diesel engine cooling water system?
options: When heating and cooling of the system was required.
When oil is used as the piston coolant.
When seawater temperatures are low.
When using jacket water to heat the fresh water generator.
CD0018 — Cooling Systems.answer: When heating and cooling of the system was required.

CD0018 — Cooling Systems.question: Which of the following types of pumps would you normally expect to find being used as the circulating pump in a diesel engine jacket cooling water system?
options: Single stage centrifugal pump.
Multi-stage centrifugal pump.
Variable delivery pump.
Positive displacement pump.
CD0018 — Cooling Systems.answer: Single stage centrifugal pump.

CD0018 — Cooling Systems.question: Complete the following statement from the options given. The purpose of a deaerator fitted in a diesel engine jacket water system is to……..
options: … assist in the removal of air, gas and vapour from the system.
… fill up the header tank,
… provide a positive suction head for the circulating pump.
… generate a cocktail shaker effect.
CD0018 — Cooling Systems.answer: … assist in the removal of air, gas and vapour from the system.

CD0018 — Cooling Systems.question: There is usually a minimum temperature recommended by the engine manufacturer for sea water used as a secondary coolant. Which of the following methods is the most common used to achieve this minimum temperature?
options: Partial recirculation of the seawater.
Preheating the seawater using electric heaters.
Mixing steam with the seawater.
Reduction of flow of the seawater.
CD0018 — Cooling Systems.answer: Partial recirculation of the seawater.

CD0018 — Cooling Systems.question: Jacket cooling water is sometimes used as the heating source for the fresh water generator. The main reason for this is to…..
options: recover waste heat to improve overall plant efficiency.
minimise the amount of sea water required as secondary coolant.
prevent fouling of the fresh water generator heat exchanger.
reduce the size of the jacket water cooler.
CD0018 — Cooling Systems.answer: recover waste heat to improve overall plant efficiency.

CD0018 — Cooling Systems.question: Which of the following options is the main purpose of a jacket cooling water system of a diesel engine?
options: To maintain the temperature of the cylinder liner and cylinder cover within recommended limits.
To cool the turbocharger and exhaust valve cages.
To allow preheating of the engine.
To cool the engine lubricating oil.
CD0018 — Cooling Systems.answer: To maintain the temperature of the cylinder liner and cylinder cover within recommended limits.

CD0018 — Cooling Systems.question: When discussing diesel engine cooling water systems the term ‘cocktail shaker effect’ refers to the cooling mechanism for which of the following?
options: Pistons
Cylinder liner.
Turbocharger.
Fuel injection valves.
CD0018 — Cooling Systems.answer: Pistons

CD0018 — Cooling Systems.question: Modern engine designs usually incorporate oil cooling of the pistons. Which of the following options is the main reason for this?
options: To eliminate the risk of water contamination of the crankcase.
Oil has a high specific capacity.
To reduce fouling of the cooling spaces.
To help preheat the engine.
CD0018 — Cooling Systems.answer: To eliminate the risk of water contamination of the crankcase.

CD0018 — Cooling Systems.question: What is the most common method used for testing the concentration of cooling water treatment in a cooling system?
options: by colour comparator
by litmus paper test
by using a hydrometer
by tasting the water
CD0018 — Cooling Systems.answer: by colour comparator

CD0018 — Cooling Systems.question: Even when engine cooling systems are filled with freshwater treatment is still required. Why is this treatment still required?
options: To prevent scale deposits and corrosion.
To reduce the total dissolved solids in the water.
To change the water colour.
To reduce the alkalinity.
CD0018 — Cooling Systems.answer: To prevent scale deposits and corrosion.

CD0018 — Cooling Systems.question: How do chemical corrosion inhibitors for engine cooling water systems generally work?
options: The chemicals react with the metals in the system to form protective passive layers on the surface of components.
The chemicals react with the metals in the system to maintain the alkalinity of the water.
The chemicals react with the metals in the system to create anodic and cathodic areas.
The chemicals react with the metals in the system to prevent scale formation.
CD0018 — Cooling Systems.answer: The chemicals react with the metals in the system to form protective passive layers on the surface of components.

CD0018 — Cooling Systems.question: Which of the following cooling water treatments are not allowed to be used when the cooling water system includes a fresh water generator?
options: Chromate based
Nitrite – borate based
Silicate based
Soluble oil
CD0018 — Cooling Systems.answer: Chromate based

CD0043 — Bilge water separator.question: Which ONE of the following is the best description of a ‘PSSA’ as described in MARPOL? Select the ONE best answer.
options: A PSSA is a Particularly Sensitive Sea Area, given special protection through action by IMO.
A PSSA is a Particularly Sensitive Sea Area, and is given the same protection as a special area.
A PSSA is a Particularly Sensitive Sea Area, in which no shipping is allowed.
A PSSA is a Polar Special Sea Area, with restrictions under the IMO’s Polar Code.
CD0043 — Bilge water separator.answer: A PSSA is a Particularly Sensitive Sea Area, given special protection through action by IMO.

CD0043 — Bilge water separator.question: A coalescing filter is used in many bilge water separators. But what do we mean by ‘coalescing’? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: Small droplets join together and unite to form one larger droplet.
Oil droplets cannot pass through the fine mesh of a filter.
Oil droplets stick to the surface of a carbon filter.
Oil droplets are absorbed into the surface of a woven fabric filter.
CD0043 — Bilge water separator.answer: Small droplets join together and unite to form one larger droplet.

CD0043 — Bilge water separator.question: The 15 ppm Bilge Alarm should record the date, time and alarm status, and operating status of the 15 ppm Bilge Separator. How long must it keep this data for? Select the one correct answer.
options: At least Eighteen months.
At least One year.
At least Six months.
Until the next IOPP Certificate renewal.
CD0043 — Bilge water separator.answer: At least Eighteen months.

CD0043 — Bilge water separator.question: Should bilge water separators be capable of handling emulsions and bilge water with a very high oil content? Select the ONE best answer.
options: Yes, but we can improve the separation process by proper management of bilge water in the engine room.
No, bilge separators cannot handle emulsions.
No, bilge separators are not designed to treat bilge water with an oil content of over 1000ppm.
Yes, they are designed to handle anything and still perform effectively.
CD0043 — Bilge water separator.answer: Yes, but we can improve the separation process by proper management of bilge water in the engine room.

CD0043 — Bilge water separator.question: What is the main purpose of the so-called ‘white box’ system fitted with some bilge separators? ^MSelect the ONE correct answer.
options: To help protect the crew and shipowner by providing evidence that operations^Mhave been legal and that there has been no tampering with the equipment.
To provide evidence of wrong doing so that ships and their owners can be ^Mprosecuted for pollution.
CD0043 — Bilge water separator.answer: To help protect the crew and shipowner by providing evidence that operations^Mhave been legal and that there has been no tampering with the equipment.

CD0043 — Bilge water separator.question: Let’s check how much you already know. Complete the sentence. ^M^M^MCurrent international legislation requires that the bilge water discharged^M ^Mby ships should contain no more than ‘how many?’ parts per million of oil in water.
Can you pump machinery space bilges whilst in a special area? Select the ONE best answer.
options: Sometimes. Machinery space bilges cannot be discharged in the Antarctic area and there may also be local restrictions.
Yes, provided that you have a modern bilge water separator meeting all requirements.
No, you can never pump machinery space bilges whilst in a special area or a PSSA.
Yes, provided you have a 5ppm bilge separator.
CD0043 — Bilge water separator.answer: Sometimes. Machinery space bilges cannot be discharged in the Antarctic area and there may also be local restrictions.

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: Which ONE of these statements best describes the most common and preferred stowage and securing arrangement on board modern container vessels?
options: Cell guides in holds, and stacked stowage and lashing with twistlocks, lashing bars and turnbuckles on deck.
Block stowage and stabilization in holds and cell guides on deck
Cell guides in holds and cell guides on deck.
Stacked stowage and securing with twistlocks, lashing rods and turnbuckles in holds and block stowage and securing with stacking cones and bridge fittings on deck.
Yes, that is correct
No, that is incorrect. The most common method is to use cell guides in holds, and stacked stowage and lashing with twistlocks, lashing bars and turnbuckles on deck.
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: Cell guides in holds, and stacked stowage and lashing with twistlocks, lashing bars and turnbuckles on deck.

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: 下面哪个说法最好地描述了现代集装箱船上最常见和首选的积载和系固装置？
options: 货舱内的导箱轨，甲板上的堆垛积载和使用扭锁、绑扎杆和螺丝扣的绑扎
货舱内的块式积载和稳定以及甲板上的导箱轨
货舱内的导箱轨和甲板上的导箱轨。
货舱内的堆垛积载和扭锁、绑扎杆和螺丝扣系固，以及甲板上的块式积载和堆垛椎体和桥连接件系固。
正确。这是正确选项。
不正确。最常用的方式是在货舱内使用导箱轨，在甲板上使用堆垛积载和扭锁、绑扎杆和螺丝扣的绑扎。
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: 货舱内的导箱轨，甲板上的堆垛积载和使用扭锁、绑扎杆和螺丝扣的绑扎

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: How is official approval assigned to the cargo securing manual?^MSelect the ONE correct answer.
options: By the classification society on behalf of the flag State.
By the company safety department after consultation with classification society
Jointly, by the ship builder and the lashing gear manufacturer.
An approved CSM is NOT required on a container ship.
Yes, that is correct.
No, that is incorrect. It is usually done by a classification society on behalf of the flag State.
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: By the classification society on behalf of the flag State.

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: 为货物系固手册指定的官方审核方式是什么？^M请选择一个正确答案。
options: 由船级社代表船旗国进行。
由公司安全部门在咨询船级社之后进行。
由船只构造商和绑扎装备制造商联合进行。
集装箱船上不需要审核的 CSM。
正确。这是正确选项。
不正确。通常由船级社代表船旗国进行。
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: 由船级社代表船旗国进行。

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: As a container is being lowered into position on board a container ship, it swings in the fore and aft plane and the actuating wire for the semi-automatic base twistlock catches under the container. ^M^MSelect the ONE best action to take in these circumstances.
options: Lift and re-land the container correctly, freeing the wire as you do so
Make a note to tell the terminal representative at the discharge port
Try and pull the wire free, attaching it to the gantry hook if necessary
Cut the wire and free the twistlock later with a spanner
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: Lift and re-land the container correctly, freeing the wire as you do so

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: 将某个集装箱放到集装箱船上的位置时，它展开了前后板，半自动底部扭锁的执行索压在了集装箱下面。 ^M请选择一个在此情况下可采取的最佳操作。
options: 正确抬升集装箱然后重新放置，同时松开绳索
进行记录，并告知卸货港口的港口代表
尝试拉出绳索，如有必要将其与门吊吊钩相连
切断绳索，之后用扳手松开扭锁
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: 正确抬升集装箱然后重新放置，同时松开绳索

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: What is the main advantage of a semi-automatic twistlock?^M^MSelect the ONE best answer.
options: Most of the models are fully compliant with OSHA requirements can be attached and removed from the container corner casting by a stevedore stationed on the dock
It relocks itself automatically if accidentally opened
Most models are fully compliant with OSHA requirements and hence require no routine maintenance
It is one of the heaviest twistlocks in its class and hence more durable
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: Most of the models are fully compliant with OSHA requirements can be attached and removed from the container corner casting by a stevedore stationed on the dock

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: 哪个是半自动扭锁的主要优点？^M请选择一个最佳答案。
options: 这是同类别最重的扭锁之一，因此更坚固
如果意外打开，则会自动重新锁定
大多数型号完全符合 OSHA 要求，因此无需定期维护
大多数型号完全符合 OSHA 要求，可以由码头上的码头装卸工将其与集装箱角铸件相连和从中拆除
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: 大多数型号完全符合 OSHA 要求，可以由码头上的码头装卸工将其与集装箱角铸件相连和从中拆除

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: Which of these statements correctly applies to a ‘hard’ open-top container in relation to container ships?^M^MSelect the ONE correct statement.
options: A ‘hard’ open top container is one that is fitted with a removable steel top and can be loaded from the top or side door with the cross-bar swung out of the container.
They are loaded with a tarpaulin sheet covering its doors and fitted all around the container.
They can be over-stowed by any other type of containers on cargo ships.
They have a lower centre of gravity than the usual 2590mm (8 feet and 6 inches) high containers.
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: A ‘hard’ open top container is one that is fitted with a removable steel top and can be loaded from the top or side door with the cross-bar swung out of the container.

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: 以下哪个说法正确描述了与集装箱船相关的“硬质”敞口集装箱？^M请选择一个正确答案。
options: “硬质”敞口集装箱带有可拆卸式钢顶板，可将横杆展开到集装箱之外从顶部门或侧面门进行装载。
在集装箱周围和门上覆盖了防水油布片。
可以通过货船上任何其他类型的集装箱进行过度积载。
其重心比普通的 2590mm (8' 6") 高的集装箱要低。
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: “硬质”敞口集装箱带有可拆卸式钢顶板，可将横杆展开到集装箱之外从顶部门或侧面门进行装载。

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: Which ONE of these is another name for a slewing eye?
options: Lashing bridge
D-ring
Pad eye
Cell guide
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: Lashing bridge

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: 下面哪个是回转孔的另一个名称？
options: 绑扎桥
D 型环
板孔
导箱轨
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: 绑扎桥

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: Which of these statements only correctly applies to the high-cube dry cargo containers?^M^MSelect the ONE correct statement.
options: They are generally used for the carriage of general break-bulk cargoes on cargo ships and bulk carriers because of their open ventilation.
The high-cube dry cargo containers are generally used for the carriage of non-perishable general cargoes and come in lengths of 20’, 40’, 45’ and 48’.
They can be stowed under-deck without any height limitations on cargo ships and bulk carriers because of their open ventilation.
They have a lower centre of gravity than the usual 2590mm (8’6”) high containers.
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: They are generally used for the carriage of general break-bulk cargoes on cargo ships and bulk carriers because of their open ventilation.

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: 下面哪个说法正确描述了高干货集装箱？^M请选择一个正确答案。
options: 由于其开放式通风，通常用于在货船和散货运输船上运输一般散货。
高干货集装箱通常用于运输不易腐坏的一般货物，有 20、40、45、48 英尺几种尺寸。
由于其开放式通风，可在货船和散货运输船上进行甲板下积载而没有任何高度限制。
其重心比普通的 2590mm (8' 6") 高的集装箱要低。
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: 高干货集装箱通常用于运输不易腐坏的一般货物，有 20、40、45、48 英尺几种尺寸。

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: Which ONE of these statements is correct?
options: The compressive forces act on a container’s corner posts and fittings as a result of tilting of stacks and vertical accelerations.
Container collapse can never result from compressive forces generated by exceeding the allowable loads on corner posts.
The risk of container failure due to compressive forces can be minimised by exceeding the weight of the upper containers in a stack.

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: The compressive forces act on a container’s corner posts and fittings as a result of tilting of stacks and vertical accelerations.

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: 以下哪个陈述是正确的？
options: 压缩力作用于集装箱的角桩和连接件上，是由于堆垛倾斜和垂直加速导致的。
集装箱倒塌绝不可能由于超过角桩上的允许负荷所产生的压缩力而导致。
通过超过堆垛中上层集装箱的重量，可以最大程度减少由于压缩力造成的集装箱损坏风险。
通过过度张紧绑扎设备，可以最大程度减少由于压缩力造成的集装箱损坏风险。
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: 压缩力作用于集装箱的角桩和连接件上，是由于堆垛倾斜和垂直加速导致的。

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: Which of these precautions should be taken when using raised ISO twistlock foundations?^M^MSelect the ONE most accurate answer.

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: 使用抬高的 ISO 扭锁基座时应该采取哪种预防措施？^M请选择一个最准确答案。
options: 此类基座应该定期检查，确保没有裂痕，因为会承受压力。
此类基座不需要定期严格检查，因为长期使用之后也不会出现裂痕
应确保插入扭锁时让锁紧杆/切换面朝向集装箱校准件外侧
标记和标签应清楚表明允许同时使用左手或右手扭锁。

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: What is the main advantage of using removable cell guides in relation to container ships?^M^MSelect the ONE correct answer.

There is no risk of damage to the cargo in the containers or in the cargo holds
They can be removed so as to accommodate carriage of high density bulk cargoes
They can be adjusted for the carriage of containers of different lengths within the same column
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: Removable container guides allow multipurpose freighters, reefer vessels, etc., to carry containers in their regular or insulated holds without any risk of damage to the holds themselves

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: 对于集装箱船使用可拆除导箱轨的主要优点是什么？^M请选择一个正确答案。
options: 可拆除集装箱导轨让多用途运输船、冷藏船等能够在普通或保温货舱内运输集装箱，而不存在损坏货舱的任何风险。
不存在损坏集装箱和货舱内货物的风险
可以拆除以容纳高密度散货
可以进行调节，以便在同一列内运输不同长度的集装箱
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: 可拆除集装箱导轨让多用途运输船、冷藏船等能够在普通或保温货舱内运输集装箱，而不存在损坏货舱的任何风险。

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: Which of these identifies the main difference between raised and sliding ISO twistlock foundations?^M^MSelect the ONE most accurate answer.
options: Dovetail foundations need to be welded onto the deck or hatch pontoon to accommodate sliding ISO twistlock foundations but not for raised types.
Sliding ISO twistlock foundations must be welded into specially designed sockets welded onto the deck or hatch pontoon but raised types do not.
Sliding ISO twistlock foundations are considered by classification societies to be less prone to stresses that raised ISO foundations.
With sliding ISO twistlock foundations, there is no problem in using left or right-handed twistlocks whereas there is with raised types.
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: Dovetail foundations need to be welded onto the deck or hatch pontoon to accommodate sliding ISO twistlock foundations but not for raised types.

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: 以下哪个是抬高的 ISO 扭锁基座和滑动式 ISO 扭锁基座的主要区别？^M请选择一个最准确答案。

滑动式 ISO 扭锁基座被船级社认为比抬高式 ISO 基座不容易承受压力。
对于滑动式 ISO 扭锁基座，使用左手或右手扭锁都没问题，而抬高类型则有问题。
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: 燕尾基座需要焊接在甲板或箱型舱盖上，以容纳滑动式 ISO 扭锁基座，但不能用于抬高类型。

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: Which ONE of the following is normally carried in type IMO5, ISO tank containers?
options: Only liquefied petroleum gases.
All inflammable liquids.
All dangerous bulk materials.
Refrigerated liquefied cargoes of any type.
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: Only liquefied petroleum gases.

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: 在 IMO5 型 ISO 罐体集装箱中，通常运输以下哪种货物？
options: 仅液化石油气。
所有可燃液体。
所有危险散料。
任何类型的冷藏液化货物。
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: 仅液化石油气。

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: Which ONE of these statements is the most accurate?
options: Convertible stowage frames were developed in order to accommodate containers of different dimensions securely, without any appreciable delay, on feeder ships, multipurpose freighters and container ships in certain regions.
The frames could not be secured at the sides by pins, which engage in bushes that are let into the wing bulkheads of the container ship.
Loaded containers cannot be locked in place by means of securing pins when using convertible stowage frames.
The closure rails, fitted on both sides of the guide rails by means of screw connections, cannot be removed once containers have been loaded when using convertible stowage frames.
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: Convertible stowage frames were developed in order to accommodate containers of different dimensions securely, without any appreciable delay, on feeder ships, multipurpose freighters and container ships in certain regions.

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: 以下哪个说法最准确？
options: 可变化积载框架是为了在某些区域的转运船、多用途运输船和集装箱船上安全容纳不同尺寸的集装箱，而不会出现任何重大延迟而设计的。

使用可变化积载框架时，一旦装载了集装箱，就无法拆除通过螺丝连接安装在导轨两侧的机箱轨道了。

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: Which ONE of these is a prime cause of excessive lashing tension in lashing rods?
options: Tightening lashing rods manually by hand
Over-tightening of lashing rods using large spanners
Inadequate lubrication of lashing equipment
Tightening turn buckles to the end of their threads
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: Tightening lashing rods manually by hand

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: 以下哪个是绑扎杆过度绑扎拉力的主要原因？
options: 用手紧固绑扎杆
使用大型扳手过度紧固绑扎杆
绑扎设备的润滑不充分
将螺丝扣拧紧至螺纹尽头
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: 使用大型扳手过度紧固绑扎杆

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: Which ONE of these is the definition of a lashing bridge as used in securing and lashing systems on container ships?
options: It is a substantial steel structure running athwartships between each forty foot container bay that allows the second and third tiers of containers to be secured to the bridge using lashing rods and turnbuckles.
It is a substantial steel structure running athwartships for safe passage of personnel during adverse weather conditions.
It is a substantial steel structure running athwartships to lash second and third tier containers for transferring excess container loads to the vessel.
It is a substantial steel structure for storing loose turnbuckles and lashing rods when they are not in use onboard ships in ballast passage.
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: It is a substantial steel structure running athwartships between each forty foot container bay that allows the second and third tiers of containers to be secured to the bridge using lashing rods and turnbuckles.

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: 以下哪个是集装箱船上系固和绑扎系统中使用的绑扎桥的定义？
options: 这是一个大型钢结构，在每个四十英尺集装箱通道之间横向运行，可使用绑扎杆和螺丝扣固定第二和第三层集装箱。
这是一个横向运行的大型钢结构，用于在恶劣天气下保证人员的安全通过。
这是一个横向运行的大型钢结构，用于绑扎第二层和第三层集装箱，将过大的集装箱符合传递到船舶上。
这是一个大型钢结构，用于在压载航行中在船上存放不使用的螺丝扣和绑扎杆。
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: 这是一个大型钢结构，在每个四十英尺集装箱通道之间横向运行，可使用绑扎杆和螺丝扣固定第二和第三层集装箱。

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: What is the main advantage of a lashing bridge as used in securing and lashing systems on container ships?^M^MSelect the ONE most accurate answer.
options: It allows anchoring points for each stack to be moved higher up the stack resulting in reduction of tipping moments.
It allows for lashing the ship’s navigating bridge with the containers loaded in front and behind it.
20 foot and 40 foot containers can be secured to it when they are required to be loaded in front of the ship’s bridge.
Ship’s torsional forces are considerably reduced as the lashing bridge transfers all the container load to the ship’s navigating bridge.
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: It allows anchoring points for each stack to be moved higher up the stack resulting in reduction of tipping moments.

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: 以下哪个是在集装箱船的系固和绑扎系统中使用绑扎桥的主要优点？^M请选择一个最准确答案。
options: 它允许每个堆垛上有多个系固点，可以向上移动到堆垛更高的位置，从而减少倾斜力矩。
它允许绑扎前后具有装货集装箱的船只导航驾驶台。
需要在船只驾驶台前面装载 20 英尺和 40 英尺集装箱时对其进行固定。
船只的扭转力会大幅减小，因为绑扎桥会将所有集装箱符合传递到船只的导航驾驶台。
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: 它允许每个堆垛上有多个系固点，可以向上移动到堆垛更高的位置，从而减少倾斜力矩。

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: What was the main reason that the stacking cones method became redundant on ‘first generation’ container vessels?^M^MSelect the ONE correct answer.
options: Increased utilisation of containers of different heights and the introduction of ‘high-cube’ containers
Recommendations in the Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS) Convention.
Recommendations from the International Maritime Organisation (IMO).
Recommendations in the cargo securing manual (CSM).
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: Increased utilisation of containers of different heights and the introduction of ‘high-cube’ containers

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: “第一代”集装箱上堆垛椎体方法成为多余的主要原因是什么？^M请选择一个正确答案。
options: 不同高度集装箱使用的增多以及高集装箱的引入
海上生命安全 (SOLAS) 公约的建议。
国际海事组织 (IMO) 的建议。
货物系固手册 (CSM) 的建议。
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: 不同高度集装箱使用的增多以及高集装箱的引入

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: Which of these does the section on ‘stack weights’, in a cargo securing manual, contain information about? ^M^MSelect the ONE correct answer.
options: This section shows the maximum hatch cover, pedestal and tank top loading and lashing system for 20' containers without lashing bridge
This section shows the maximum number of stacks that can be loaded on cargo ships with respect to their size and types along with loading of general cargo
This section shows the maximum number of stacks that can be loaded on bulk carrier ships with respect to their size and types when not loading break bulk cargo
This section shows how to use load-bearing base twistlocks, bridge fittings, lashing bridges, single and double stacking cones in conjunction with lashing bars or lashing chains
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: This section shows the maximum hatch cover, pedestal and tank top loading and lashing system for 20' containers without lashing bridge

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: 货物系固手册中的“堆垛重量”部分包含了以下哪些相关信息？ ^M请选择一个正确答案。
options: 此部分显示了不带绑扎桥的 20 英尺集装箱的最大舱口盖、底板和底舱顶板负载和绑扎系统数目。
此部分根据货船大小和类型显示了装载一般货物时可装载的最大堆垛数量
此部分根据货船大小和类型显示了不装载散货时散货运输船可装载的最大堆垛数量
此部分显示了如何使用负荷承受底部扭锁、桥连接件、绑扎桥、单双堆垛椎体和绑扎杆或绑扎链
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: 此部分显示了不带绑扎桥的 20 英尺集装箱的最大舱口盖、底板和底舱顶板负载和绑扎系统数目。

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: What are intermediate stackers used for?^M^MSelect the ONE best answer.
options: Securing containers inside cargo holds and container stacks into composite units
Securing containers of different height
Securing containers on deck
Securing containers of different length
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: Securing containers inside cargo holds and container stacks into composite units

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: 中间接卡箱的用处是什么？^M请选择一个最佳答案。
options: 系固不同长度的集装箱
系固不同高度的集装箱
系固甲板上的集装箱
将货舱内的集装箱和集装箱堆垛系固在组合装备上
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: 将货舱内的集装箱和集装箱堆垛系固在组合装备上

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: ‘A cargo securing manual (CSM) must be approved by…^M^MSelect the ONE phrase that most accurately completes the above statement.
options: ...the shipowner in consultation with the classification society.’
...the classification society in consultation with the ship owner.’
...a classification society on behalf of a flag State.’
...the ship yard in consultation with the shipowner and the naval architect.’
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: ...the shipowner in consultation with the classification society.’

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: “货物系固手册 (CSM) 的审核必须由…^M请选择一个选项以最准确地完成上面的陈述。
options: ...船东咨询船级社进行。”
...船级社咨询船只进行。”
...由船级社代表船旗国进行。”
...船厂咨询船东和造船工程师进行。”
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: ...由船级社代表船旗国进行。”

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: Which ONE of these is a disadvantage of a lashing bridge as used in securing and lashing systems on container ships?
options: Only one end of 40 foot containers can be secured to it when empty.
45 foot containers cannot be secured to it due to their exceptional weight and size.
Only one end of 20 foot containers can be secured to it due to the limited capacity of the conventional lashing system.
It can only be fitted athwartships, across 20 foot container bays due to the limited capacity depending on the container ship’s size.
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: Only one end of 40 foot containers can be secured to it when empty.

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: 以下哪个是在集装箱船上的系固和绑扎系统中使用绑扎桥的缺点？
options: 只能固定 40 英尺空集装箱的一端。
由于 45 英尺集装箱的异常重量和尺寸而无法对其进行固定。
由于传统绑扎系统的容量有限，只能固定 20 英尺集装箱的一端。
由于空间有限，只能集装箱船的规模穿越 20 英尺集装箱通道进行横向安装。
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: 由于传统绑扎系统的容量有限，只能固定 20 英尺集装箱的一端。

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: What is the main advantage in using automatic locking cones?^M^MSelect the ONE best answer.
options: Some units combine the function of both the semi-automatic twistlocks (SAT) and the midlock and as such operating of cones during cargo operations are fully automatic
Their flangeless design leads to a higher centre of gravity
Dedicated operating rods are supplied for use in conjunction with the cones in case of their automatic function failure
Their flangeless design leads to a higher centre of gravity as well as large GM
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: Some units combine the function of both the semi-automatic twistlocks (SAT) and the midlock and as such operating of cones during cargo operations are fully automatic

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: 使用自动锁紧椎体的主要优点是什么？^M请选择一个最佳答案。
options: 自动功能故障时，提供了专门的操作杆来与这些椎体一起使用
其无法兰设计会升高重心
某些装置结合了半自动扭锁 (SAT) 和锥锁的功能，因此在货物作业期间椎体的操作是完全自动化的
其无法兰设计会升高重心和增大 GM
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: 某些装置结合了半自动扭锁 (SAT) 和锥锁的功能，因此在货物作业期间椎体的操作是完全自动化的

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: Which of these statements normally applies to cargo securing manuals in relation to a container ship?^M^MSelect the ONE correct statement.
options: They contain ship-specific information about securing of containerised cargo on deck that varies from ship to ship
They contain ship-specific information about different container securing arrangements each having its own permissible stack and tier weight limits
They contain general information about manually securing of different types of containers only
They contain general information about loading, stowage and securing containers as approved by the local port State administration
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: They contain ship-specific information about securing of containerised cargo on deck that varies from ship to ship

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: 以下哪个说法正确描述了与集装箱船相关的货物系固手册？^M请选择一个正确答案。
options: 其中包含了每个船只具体的甲板上集装箱货物系固的信息。
其中包含了不同集装箱系固装置的船只特定信息，其中每个装置都由自己的允许堆垛和层重量限制。
其中仅包含了手动系固各种集装箱的一般信息
其中包含了当地港口国管理机构审核的装货、积载和系固集装箱的一般信息
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: 其中包含了不同集装箱系固装置的船只特定信息，其中每个装置都由自己的允许堆垛和层重量限制。

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: What disadvantage does an under deck lashing arrangement that uses pressure elements, have?^M^MSelect the ONE best answer.
options: Each tier of containers in the same block needs to be of the same height and all the containers in the same block must be for same port of discharge
If an individual pressure element breaks the whole block of containers is affected
All the containers in the same block must be for same port of discharge but they all must be of one size only
If over three units high, containers in the same block need to be secured with extra locking pins
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: Each tier of containers in the same block needs to be of the same height and all the containers in the same block must be for same port of discharge

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: 使用压力元件的甲板下绑扎装置的缺点是什么？^M请选择一个最佳答案。
options: 如果一个压力元件破裂，则整个集装箱装置均受影响。
同一个装置内的每层集装箱需要为相同高度，同一个装置内的所有集装箱均须在同一个港口卸货
同一个装置内的所有集装箱均须在同一个港口卸货，但全部必须为一个尺寸
如果超过三个装置高，则同一个装置内的集装箱需要使用另外的锁紧销进行系固
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: 同一个装置内的每层集装箱需要为相同高度，同一个装置内的所有集装箱均须在同一个港口卸货

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: What is the main disadvantage of using double and quadruple stacking cones?^M^MSelect the ONE best answer.
options: They can only be used where adjacent stacks are of the same height and where inter-connected stacks are for discharge at the same port
They cannot be used to secure loaded containers into a single block
Frequent inspection and excessive levels of maintenance are required
They cannot be used where adjacent stacks are of same heights and where inter-connected stacks are welded inside the holds
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: They can only be used where adjacent stacks are of the same height and where inter-connected stacks are for discharge at the same port

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: 使用双和四堆垛椎体的主要缺点是什么？^M请选择一个最佳答案。
options: 需要频繁检查和大量维护
不能用于将装货集装箱固定在单个装置中。
只能在相邻堆垛高度相同且互相连接的堆垛在同一个港口卸货的情况下使用。
相邻堆垛高度相同且互相连接的堆垛在货舱内部焊接时不能使用。
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: 只能在相邻堆垛高度相同且互相连接的堆垛在同一个港口卸货的情况下使用。

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: Which ONE of these is the best description of a lashing bridge?
options: It is a substantial athwartships steel structure used for the better lashing of second and third tier containers.
It is a movable under-deck cell guide, which facilitates the stowage of containers of different lengths within the same hold.
It is a substantial longitudinal steel structure used for the lashing of second and third tier containers.
It is an alternative term for a colour-coded steel plate, welded to the ship’s structure, onto which lashing rods and turnbuckles are secured.
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: It is a substantial athwartships steel structure used for the better lashing of second and third tier containers.

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: 下面哪个是绑扎桥的最佳描述？
options: 这是一个横向运行的大型钢结构，用于更好地绑扎第二层和第三层集装箱。
这是一个可移动的甲板下导箱轨，可以实现在一个货舱内积载不同长度的集装箱。
这是一个纵向运行的大型钢结构，用于绑扎第二层和第三层集装箱。
这是带颜色钢板的另一种说法，此钢板焊接在船只结构上，在此处系固绑扎杆和螺丝扣。
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: 这是一个横向运行的大型钢结构，用于更好地绑扎第二层和第三层集装箱。

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: The number of lashing rods used and positions, in which they are fitted on container stacks, are determined by a number of factors. ^M^MSelect the ONE correct pair of factors.
options: The stack weight and the weight of each container in the stack
The container weight and the weight of each container in the column
The container weight and the weight of each container in the row
The container size and the weight of each container in the stack
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: The stack weight and the weight of each container in the stack

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: 使用的绑扎杆数量及其在集装箱堆垛上的安装位置由一系列因素确定。 ^M请选择一对正确因素。
options: 堆垛重量和其中每个集装箱的重量。
集装箱重量和列中每个集装箱的重量。
集装箱重量和行中每个集装箱的重量。
集装箱大小和堆垛中每个集装箱的重量。
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: 堆垛重量和其中每个集装箱的重量。

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: Which of these contains the names of two types of fixed ISO container fittings?^M^MSelect the ONE correct answer.
options: Raised and sliding ISO twistlock foundations
Automatic and semi-automatic twistlocks
Midlocks and deadlocks
Sliding and non-sliding ISO twistlock foundations
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: Raised and sliding ISO twistlock foundations

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: 以下哪个是两种固定 ISO 集装箱连接件的名称？^M请选择一个正确答案。
options: 锥锁和死锁
自动和半自动扭锁
抬高和滑动式 ISO 扭锁基座
滑动和非滑动式 ISO 扭锁基座
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: 抬高和滑动式 ISO 扭锁基座

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: Which of these should be contained in the section on ‘Equipment Operating Instructions’, in a cargo securing manual? ^M^MSelect the ONE correct answer.
options: The ‘Equipment Operating Instructions’ should include instructions on the use of twistlocks, actuator poles, turnbuckles and midlock stackers and should illustrate lashing operations using short and long rods
The ‘Equipment Operating Instructions’ should include instructions on the use of compressors and generators for reefer cargoes and illustrates their detailed operating instructions

The ‘Equipment Operating Instructions’ should include instructions on the use of various types of container handling equipment required for loading and unloading of containers securely on general cargo ships

The ‘Equipment Operating Instructions’ should include instructions on the use of various types of container handling equipment required for loading and unloading of containers securely on break bulk carriers
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: The ‘Equipment Operating Instructions’ should include instructions on the use of twistlocks, actuator poles, turnbuckles and midlock stackers and should illustrate lashing operations using short and long rods

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: 货物系固手册中的“设备操作说明”部分应包含以下哪个信息？ ^M请选择一个正确答案。
options: “设备操作说明”应包括使用扭锁、执行机构杆、螺丝扣和锥锁接卡箱的说明，并且图示说明使用短杆和长杆的绑扎操作。
“设备操作说明”应包括使用冷藏集装箱货物压缩机和发电机的说明，并且图示说明详细的操作说明
“设备操作说明”应包括对一般货船上的集装箱进行安全装货和卸货所需的各种集装箱处理设备的使用说明。
“设备操作说明”应包括对散料运输船上的集装箱进行安全装货和卸货所需的各种集装箱处理设备的使用说明。
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: “设备操作说明”应包括使用扭锁、执行机构杆、螺丝扣和锥锁接卡箱的说明，并且图示说明使用短杆和长杆的绑扎操作。

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: What was the main limitation of the lashing equipment manufacturer's manual on ‘first generation’ container vessels?^M^MSelect the ONE correct answer.
options: An ideal stow, referred to as the ‘homogenous stack’, was assumed.
Manuals were available only in the ‘English’ language.
Calm weather conditions were assumed during the voyage.
No lashing equipment description was provided.
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: An ideal stow, referred to as the ‘homogenous stack’, was assumed.

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: “第一代”集装箱上绑扎设备制造商的主要限制是什么？^M请选择一个正确答案。
options: 假设为理想积载，称为“同质堆垛”。
手册仅提供“英语”版本。
假设航行中为无风天气情况。
未提供绑扎设备说明。
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: 假设为理想积载，称为“同质堆垛”。

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: Which ONE of these statements is the most accurate?
options: Containers tend to pivot on the bottom edge and may eventually overturn when subjected to toppling forces caused by rolling motion of the ship due to extreme heavy weather conditions.
Containers tend to stay in position as they naturally counteract toppling forces caused by extreme rolling motion of the ship due to extreme heavy weather conditions.
Containers tend to lift from the bottom edge which may disconnect the corner castings or twistlocks when subject to toppling forces caused by extreme heavy weather conditions in port.
Containers tend to stay upright when fully loaded even when subjected to the toppling forces caused by extreme heavy weather conditions resulting in smooth rolling motion while in port.
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: Containers tend to pivot on the bottom edge and may eventually overturn when subjected to toppling forces caused by rolling motion of the ship due to extreme heavy weather conditions.

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: 以下哪个说法最准确？
options: 当集装箱由于极端恶劣天气下的船只横摇动作而承受倾斜力时，可能会基于底边进行枢转，最终产生过度旋转。
集装箱会保持原位，因为它们会自然抵消由于极端恶劣天气下的船只横摇动作而导致的倾斜力。
在港口由于极端恶劣天气而承受倾斜力时，集装箱会从底边抬起，可能会断开角铸件或扭锁。
集装箱在满载时会保持直立，甚至当其港口由于平滑横摇动作而在极端恶劣天气下承受倾斜力时也是如此。
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: 当集装箱由于极端恶劣天气下的船只横摇动作而承受倾斜力时，可能会基于底边进行枢转，最终产生过度旋转。

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: Which of these is a recognized potential deficiency of dovetail foundations when securing containers?^M^MSelect the ONE most appropriate answer.
options: The chamfered edges are particularly susceptible to damage by compression and to flaring outwards when in use
The chamfered edges are particularly susceptible to damage by flaring outwards in bad weather conditions even when not in use
When damaged, sliding fixtures cannot be properly handled and stored
The versatility of a stowage arrangement is seriously reduced if dovetail foundations are incorporated
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: The chamfered edges are particularly susceptible to damage by compression and to flaring outwards when in use

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: 系固集装箱时，下面哪个是燕尾基座的潜在缺陷？^M请选择一个最准确答案。
options: 使用时，倒角边缘尤其可能受到压缩或向外扩张的力量的损坏。
倒角边缘尤其可能受到恶劣天气下向外扩张力量的损坏，即使不使用时也是如此。
损坏后，滑动式装置无法恰当搬运和存放
如果使用燕尾基座，积载装置的灵活性会严重降低
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: 使用时，倒角边缘尤其可能受到压缩或向外扩张的力量的损坏。

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: Which of the statements regarding the combined static and dynamic loads acting on container securing systems of ‘second generation’ container vessels is true?^M^MSelect the ONE most accurate answer.
options: The combined static and dynamic loads acting on a securing system during adverse weather were not considered and there were no uniform standards for container lashing systems.
The combined static and dynamic loads acting on a securing system during adverse weather were considered and presumed to be correct.
The containers were correctly stowed with the assumption that the lashing recommendations in the cargo securing manual (CSM) took static and dynamic loads into account.
There were no cargo securing manuals for non-cellular container ships so the static and dynamic loads were not recognised.
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: The combined static and dynamic loads acting on a securing system during adverse weather were not considered and there were no uniform standards for container lashing systems.

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: 关于作用于“第二代”集装箱船的集装箱系固系统上的综合静态和动态负荷，以下哪个说法是真的？^M请选择一个最准确答案。
options: 未考虑恶劣天气下作用于系固系统的组合静态和动态负荷，集装箱绑扎系统没有统一标准。
考虑了恶劣天气下作用于系固系统的组合静态和动态负荷，并且假定是正确的。
集装箱正确积载，且假设货物系固手册 (CSM) 中的绑扎建议考虑了静态和动态负荷。
非格导式集装箱船没有货物系固手册，因此未确定静态和动态负荷。
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: 未考虑恶劣天气下作用于系固系统的组合静态和动态负荷，集装箱绑扎系统没有统一标准。

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: What is the main advantage in using double and quadruple stacking cones?^M^MSelect the ONE best answer.
options: They secure loaded containers into a single block
No inspection or maintenance is required
They can be used where adjacent stacks are of different heights
They can be used even where inter-connected stacks are for discharge at different ports
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: They secure loaded containers into a single block

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: 使用双和四堆垛椎体的主要优点是什么？^M请选择一个最佳答案。
options: 无需检查或维护
会将满载的集装箱系固在一个装置中
可在相邻堆垛高度不同时使用
相互连接的堆垛要在不同港口卸货时也可使用
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: 会将满载的集装箱系固在一个装置中

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: Which of these identifies the primary resultant effects on container stacks of the vessel ‘rolling’?^M^MSelect the ONE correct answer.
options: Racking force is the primary resultant transverse effect caused by a vessel’s rolling motion that tends to distort a container’s end or its side frames, resulting from static and dynamic forces parallel to the deck.
Racking force is the primary resultant longitudinal effect caused by a vessel’s rolling motion that tends to damage a container and its cargo, resulting in spilling of cargo on the deck.

Racking force is the primary resultant effect caused due to the vessel’s rolling motion. It is an arthward force that tends to distort a container’s contents temporarily, resulting from static and dynamic forces perpendicular to the deck.
Racking force is the primary resultant effect caused by a vessel’s rolling motion that virtually damages the container ship itself and is the result of static and dynamic forces inside the hull.
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: Racking force is the primary resultant transverse effect caused by a vessel’s rolling motion that tends to distort a container’s end or its side frames, resulting from static and dynamic forces parallel to the deck.

CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.question: 以下哪项是船舶“横摇”时对集装箱堆垛产生的主要影响？^M请选择一个正确答案。
options: 横斜歪变形力是船舶“横摇”时产生的主要横向效果，由于与甲板平行的静态力和动态力而产生，容易让集装箱端部或侧部框架变形。
横斜歪变形力是船舶“横摇”时产生的主要纵向效果，由于甲板上的货物喷溅而产生，容易损坏集装箱及其货物。
横斜歪变形力是由于船舶“横摇”动作导致的主要效果。它是由于与甲板垂直的静态力和动态力而产生的一种横向力，容易让集装箱货物临时变形。
横斜歪变形力是船舶“横摇”时产生的主要横向效果，由于船体内的静态力和动态力而产生，会真正损坏集装箱船本身。
CD0045 — Container Lashings - Basic.answer: 横斜歪变形力是船舶“横摇”时产生的主要横向效果，由于与甲板平行的静态力和动态力而产生，容易让集装箱端部或侧部框架变形。

Some fuel will continue to burn until the exhaust gas has passed the exhaust boiler
The fuel is ignited twice to obtain a more clean combustion
When the combustion continues after the injection has ended

CD0047 — Fuel Combustion Efficiency.question: The maximum cylinder pressure will be lower than normal when?
options: You have an early injection of fuel
You have a late injection of fuel
The mean indicated pressure is higher than normal
The cylinder liner temperature is below normal

CD0047 — Fuel Combustion Efficiency.question: The cylinder liner temperature is lower than normal when?
options: You have an early injection of fuel
You have a late injection of fuel
You have a poor atomisation of the fuel
Increased RPM

CD0047 — Fuel Combustion Efficiency.question: What is the effect of high viscosity on after burning?
options: The after burning will be reduced due to better atomisation of fuel
Viscosity has no effect on after burning
The after burning will last longer due to increased droplet size
Fuel pump capacity will be reduced and give less after burning
CD0047 — Fuel Combustion Efficiency.answer: The after burning will last longer due to increased droplet size

CD0047 — Fuel Combustion Efficiency.question: The maximum cylinder pressure will be higher than normal when?
options: You have a late injection of fuel
The fuel valve opening pressure is too high
You have an early injection of fuel
You have a leaking fuel valve
CD0047 — Fuel Combustion Efficiency.answer: You have an early injection of fuel

CD0047 — Fuel Combustion Efficiency.question: A too late combustion leads to?
options: Decreased exhaust gas temperature
No change in exhaust gas temperature
Reduced soot formation and cleaner turbo chargers
Increased exhaust gas temperature

CD0047 — Fuel Combustion Efficiency.question: A large increase in cylinder pressure occurs
options: When there is a small delay between beginning of injection and actual ignition
When there is a large delay between beginning of injection and actual ignition
When there is no delay between beginning of injection and actual ignition
CD0047 — Fuel Combustion Efficiency.answer: When there is a large delay between beginning of injection and actual ignition

CD0047 — Fuel Combustion Efficiency.question: How will a large content of “Cat fines” in the fuel influence the injection timing?
options: Cat fines will improve the fuel quality and lead to early injection
Cat fines will have no influence on the injection and combustion
Cat fines will improve the atomisation and thus the combustion
Abrasive wear of pumps and valves will lead to late injection
CD0047 — Fuel Combustion Efficiency.answer: Abrasive wear of pumps and valves will lead to late injection

CD0047 — Fuel Combustion Efficiency.question: The purpose of suction valve is

To avoid additional opening of injection valves
To prevent sticking of fuel pump plunger
CD0047 — Fuel Combustion Efficiency.answer: To avoid additional opening of injection valves

CD0047 — Fuel Combustion Efficiency.question: The combustion process starts when
options: The fuel pump starts working
The exhaust valve is closed
When there is an increase in cylinder pressure

CD0047 — Fuel Combustion Efficiency.question: The opening of the Exhaust valve in MAN B&W MC engines is by

Fuel Oil pressure
Hydraulic oil pressure

CD0047 — Fuel Combustion Efficiency.question: Fuel must be atomized and distributed finely through the combustion chamber
options: To increase the pumping volume
To increase the surface area available for ignition
To prevent fuel accumulation

CD0047 — Fuel Combustion Efficiency.question: The purpose of VIT is
options: To optimize fuel economy at part load
To optimize fuel economy at full load
To reduce wear on fuel pumps
CD0047 — Fuel Combustion Efficiency.answer: To optimize fuel economy at part load

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: How would gas detector tubes normally be used to simultaneously check for the presence and concentration of more than one toxic gas?
options: Use a single sample pump with a preselected tube set in a multiple tube holder.
Use a single detector tube that will react with all of the gases to be checked.
Use a number of hand pumps each fitted with tubes for detecting individual gases.
Use a single sample pump with a random selection of tubes in a multiple tube holder.
CD0048 — Gas Measurement.answer: Use a single sample pump with a preselected tube set in a multiple tube holder.

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: What should be considered the main advantage of using a personal gas monitor when working in a space where the presence of a toxic gas is a potential hazard?
options: It  gives continuous monitoring at the location of the work activity.
It gives a check of the initial pre entry test readings.
It eliminates the need for pre entry checks of the atmosphere.
It eliminates the need to have breathing apparatus standing by.
CD0048 — Gas Measurement.answer: It  gives continuous monitoring at the location of the work activity.

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: With respect to gas detection instruments what is the purpose of carrying out a ‘bump test’?
options: To check of the instrument reading against a known concentration of gas.
To check the effect of a heavy impact on the instrument reading.
To establish the zero setting of the instrument before use.
To recalibrate the instrument for a fixed reading of gas concentration.
CD0048 — Gas Measurement.answer: To check of the instrument reading against a known concentration of gas.

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: Which of the options given would normally be associated with colorimetric testing in relation to the detection of toxic gases?
options: Chemical gas detector tubes
Catalytic filament instruments
Galvanic cell instruments
Infra red absorption devices
CD0048 — Gas Measurement.answer: Chemical gas detector tubes

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: Which term is normally used to describe the property of a gas that has a harmful effect on a living organism as a result of a single short term exposure?
options: Acute toxicity
Chronic toxicity
High toxicity
Short toxicity
CD0048 — Gas Measurement.answer: Acute toxicity

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: Threshold limit values for exposure to toxic gases are often given as guidance to ensure safety of personnel working where the gases may be present. Which of the threshold limits given in the options would normally have the highest numerical value?
options: TLV - C
TLV - TWA
TLV - STEL
TLV - LTEL
CD0048 — Gas Measurement.answer: TLV - C

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: What would be the normal source of information regarding the possible presence of a toxic gas due to the carriage of a particular cargo?
options: Material safety data sheet for the cargo (MSDS)
Code of safe working practices (COSWP)
Safety of life at sea (SOLAS)
International Safety Guide for Oil Tanker and Terminals (ISGOTT)
CD0048 — Gas Measurement.answer: Material safety data sheet for the cargo (MSDS)

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: Why is purging of a cargo tank with inert gas normally carried out?
options: To reduce the hydrocarbon gas content to below the critical dilution level.
To inert the tank.
To reduce the oxygen content to 8%  or less.
To ensure the tank atmosphere is over rich.
CD0048 — Gas Measurement.answer: To reduce the hydrocarbon gas content to below the critical dilution level.

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: From the options given select the one which is the best approximation of the make up of normal atmospheric air.
options: 21% oxygen and 79% nitrogen
79% oxygen and 21% nitrogen
11% oxygen and 89% nitrogen
89% oxygen and 11% nitrogen
CD0048 — Gas Measurement.answer: 21% oxygen and 79% nitrogen

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: According to the ISGOTT definition what is a toxic gas?
options: A gas which is harmful to human life.
A gas which if flammable.
Any gas other than oxygen.
A gas mixture containing hydrocarbon gas.
CD0048 — Gas Measurement.answer: A gas which is harmful to human life.

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: From the options given select the one that is generally accepted as the minimum oxygen content to support combustion.
What would be the most common source of hydrogen sulphide gas being present in onboard spaces of a ship?
options: Sour crude or petroleum products from sour crude in tanks.
Low sulphur marine fuel oil being used in a diesel engine.
Combustion of distillate fuel oil in the inert gas generator.
Incomplete combustion of fuel oil in a boiler furnace.
CD0048 — Gas Measurement.answer: Sour crude or petroleum products from sour crude in tanks.

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: A sampling pump for an oxygen analyser with a capacity of 100ml per stroke connected to a 10 metre sampling line with a capacity of 25 ml per metre is being used to obtain a sample of a cargo tanks atmosphere. How many strokes of the pump are required to ensure that a truly representative sample is obtained in practice?
When carrying out checks of the atmosphere in a cargo tank following gas freeing how many levels in the tank should samples be taken to ensure there are no variations in the tank atmosphere?
options: At least three levels
At least two levels
One level is sufficient
Samples should be taken every metre depth in the tank.
CD0048 — Gas Measurement.answer: At least three levels

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: What would be the likely outcome if the combustion control of an independent inert gas generator, supplying inert gas to a cargo tank system, was incorrectly set resulting in poor combustion?
options: Increased level of carbon monoxide in the inert gas.
Increased level of hydrogen sulphide gas in the inert gas.
Increased level of oxygen in the inert gas.
Increased level of NOx and SOx in the inert gas.
CD0048 — Gas Measurement.answer: Increased level of carbon monoxide in the inert gas.

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: It is generally recommended that non metallic sampling lines and sensors are used when obtaining gas samples from cargo tanks. What additional precautions are required when taking samples during inerting of a cargo tank?
options: The inerting operation should be stopped for at least 30 minutes before introducing sampling equipment into the tank.
It is safe to take samples during inerting.
The inerting operation should be stopped while samples are obtained.
Samples should never be taken from a partly inerted tank.
CD0048 — Gas Measurement.answer: The inerting operation should be stopped for at least 30 minutes before introducing sampling equipment into the tank.

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: What facility is normally provided for making a zero adjustment to a paramagnetic oxygen analyser?
options: Alter relative position of optical system.
Change the rating of the light source lamp.
Adjust the electrical circuit.
Reposition the meter needle to zero.
CD0048 — Gas Measurement.answer: Alter relative position of optical system.

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: What work related recommendations are covered by IMO Resolution A864(20)?
options: The recommendations for entering an enclosed space onboard a ship
Those for inerting a cargo tank onboard a tanker
Those for operating an inert gas plant onboard a tanker
Those for crude oil washing a cargo tank
CD0048 — Gas Measurement.answer: The recommendations for entering an enclosed space onboard a ship

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: When obtaining a representative sample of the atmosphere of an enclosed space for purposes of determining the oxygen content what action should be taken with the ventilation of the space?
options: It should be stopped for 10 minutes before sampling
It should be increased for 10 minutes before sampling
It should be reduced for 10 minutes before sampling
Normal ventilation should be maintained during sampling
CD0048 — Gas Measurement.answer: It should be stopped for 10 minutes before sampling

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: Which material is recommended for the removal of carbon dioxide from a gas sample when measuring the hydrocarbon gas content of an inerted cargo tank atmosphere with a refractive index or infrared absorption type detector?

Cotton wool
Silica gel
Gauze
CD0048 — Gas Measurement.answer: Sodalime

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: What should be used as the reference gas when carrying out the zero setting of a combustible or hydrocarbon gas detecting instrument?
options: Fresh air
Inert gas
2% butane in nitrogen
Pure oxygen
CD0048 — Gas Measurement.answer: Fresh air

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: Many of the oxygen analysers used onboard ship use paramagnetic type sensors. What is meant by the term ‘Paramagnetic’?
options: That a material is temporarily magnetized when exposed to a magnetic field.
That a material is permanently magnetized when exposed to a magnetic field.
That a material is non magnetic under any circumstances.
That a material is repelled by a magnetic field.
CD0048 — Gas Measurement.answer: That a material is temporarily magnetized when exposed to a magnetic field.

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: What should be used for the span adjustment of a galvanic cell type oxygen analyser which is to be used for checking low concentrations of oxygen?
options: A test gas with 2% oxygen and 98% nitrogen
Fresh air
Inert gas with 8% or less oxygen content
A test gas with 2% butane and 98% nitrogen
CD0048 — Gas Measurement.answer: A test gas with 2% oxygen and 98% nitrogen

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: When carrying out a span check of a combustible or hydrocarbon gas detector the sample gas should normally be taken from a gas bag rather than direct from the gas canister? Why should this procedure be followed?
options: To avoid excess pressure or flow in the instrument.
To control the quantity of test gas used.
To reduce the temperature of the test gas by expanding it into the bag.
Connection of the gas bag to the instrument is easier.
CD0048 — Gas Measurement.answer: To avoid excess pressure or flow in the instrument.

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: If the oxygen content in an enclosed space falls below 21% during entry by personnel what action should be taken?
options: Stop working and leave the space immediately
Complete the work as quickly as possible
Stop the work and put on breathing apparatus before carrying on
Increase the ventilation and continue working
CD0048 — Gas Measurement.answer: Stop working and leave the space immediately

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: If the oxygen content of an enclosed space is less than 20% under what conditions should entry be made by personnel?
options: In an emergency only using suitable breathing equipment
For a short period only using breathing equipment
Using breathing equipment
Only in pairs using breathing equipment
CD0048 — Gas Measurement.answer: In an emergency only using suitable breathing equipment

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: What reading will be obtained if a explosimeter, with a range of 0 – 100% LEL, is used to check the hydrocarbon gas content in an atmosphere containing a concentration of hydrocarbon gas which is three times the LEL.
options: The meter needle will move to full scale deflection and then fall close to zero.
The meter needle will move to full scale deflection and remain there.
The meter reading will stay at zero.
The meter reading will oscillate between full scale deflection and zero.

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: Which material is normally used to remove dirt and moisture from a gas sample prior to entry into a combustible gas indicator?
options: Cotton wool
Soda lime
Cardboard
Paper

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: What precautions should be taken prior to use when using an oxygen analyser that has automatic calibration?
options: The analyser should be switched on in fresh air
The analyser should be switched on 30 minutes before use
The analyser should be switched on with the sensor placed in the space to be tested
No precautions are necessary

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: Which gas would be most likely to affect the reading from a refractive index type hydrocarbon gas measuring instrument?

options: Checking the reading of the instrument against a known concentration of test gas.

Knocking the instrument to see if the meter needle is sticking.

1% by volume
5% by volume

To replace the contents with inert gas

To remove the inert gas only

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: What should be used when checking the span during calibration of a combustible gas or hydrocarbon gas detector?

A known concentration of butane in inert gas.
Fresh air.

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: What would be the effect, if any, on the meter reading of a catalytic filament type combustible gas indicator if the oxygen content of the sample was less than 11%?

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: What is the time period that is normally used when stating threshold limit values for the time weighted average for exposure, TLV – TWA, for toxic gases?

1 hours
15 minutes
24 hours

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: What is the effect on the oxygen content of the atmosphere of an enclosed space if hydrocarbon gases are present?

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: Which of the following toxicity threshold limit exposure terms would normally have the lowest numerical value?

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: Which type of hydrocarbon gas detecting instrument uses thermal conductivity of the gas as the means of measuring gas content in a sample?

5 minutes

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: What might indicate that a galvanic cell type oxygen measuring instrument requires a replacement sensor cell?

Reading less than 8% oxygen when testing an inerted cargo tank atmosphere

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: What is the normally accepted value for the upper explosive limit, UEL, for hydrocarbon gas in a cargo tank?

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: What simple test can be carried out to check for leaks in a bulb type aspirator pump for a gas detecting instrument?

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: Which term is normally used to describe the property of a gas that has a long term harmful effect on a living organism as a result of repeated or long term exposure to even low concentrations of the gas?

Acute toxicity

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: Metal oxide semiconductor type sensors are increasingly being used in personal gas monitors. What is the operating principle of this type of sensor?

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: How is the correct volume of the sample controlled when using short term gas detector tubes with a manually operated hand pump?

By always using a single complete stroke of the pump for each tube.
By always using a fixed number of complete strokes of the pump for each tube.
By always operating the pump for the same period of time for each tube.

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: What is the most likely reason for the presence of high levels of NOx and SOx gases in the atmosphere of a cargo tank on an oil tanker?

A cargo of heavy fuel oil with a high sulphur content has been carried in the tank.
The tank has been fully gas freed following discharge of cargo.

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: How is a time weighted average reading obtained from a diffusion type detector tube that has been used over a working period of eight hours?

Multiply the total reading on the tube by 8.
Take a direct total reading from the tube.
Half the reading on the tube to get a mid point reading.

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: What is the main advantage of using a personal gas monitor rather than a long term gas detector tube when working in a potentially hazardous space?

The personal monitor can be used to check total exposure throughout the working period.

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: For a correctly inerted cargo tank, what would be the expected oxygen content reading obtained during checks with a portable oxygen analyser?

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: What would a portable instrument employing a paramagnetic sensor normally be used for during enclosed space checks onboard ship?

Checking for the presence of toxic gases in the atmosphere

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: Why do galvanic type oxygen sensors have a limited life?

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: What is the generally accepted oxygen requirement necessary before safe entry into an enclosed space onboard ship?

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: Where would you expect to find specific procedures regarding entry into enclosed spaces and atmosphere testing for a vessel you are sailing on?

Code of Safe Working Practices
MAIB reports

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: What will happen to the meter reading when using a non-catalytic heated filament combustible gas detector with a range setting of 0 – 100% LEL in an atmosphere containing a high concentration of hydrocarbon gas?

Rise to a maximum and then fall back to zero.
No reading.

CD0048 — Gas Measurement.question: Why is it necessary to check the oxygen content of an enclosed space atmosphere before using a catalytic filament type combustible gas detector (Explosimeter)?

CD0049 — Radar Observation and plotting.question: What is the correct type of radar display to be selected when at sea?

Always use Ship’s Head-up unstabilised display.
Always a North-up Stabilized Relative Motion display.
Always a North-up Stabilized True Motion display.

CD0049 — Radar Observation and plotting.question: What radar range should be selected to suit all conditions?

The 12 mile range with frequent changes to higher ranges to determine distant targets.
The range most suitable to the proximity of targets and land, but with frequent checks of higher and lower ranges.
The 6 mile range with frequent observations of the 12 mile range.

CD0049 — Radar Observation and plotting.question: What is the purpose of determining the Aspect of a target vessel ?

Determine the probable reflective properties of the target.
Avoid a collision risk developing.

The radar ability to pick up large targets.
The radar ability to pick up small targets.

Ice.
Snow.
Light waves.

Distance to the radar horizon not effected.
