可燃。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 太贫。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: All substances have a unique chemical composition throughout. What chemical term is used to describe this?
options: Homogeneous.
Homocyclic.
Unilateral.
Homopolymer.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: Homogeneous.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 所有物质均具有一种独特的整体化学组成成分。哪个化学属于用于描述这种情况？
options: 同种。
同素。
单方。
同聚物。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 同种。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: What is an “article”?
options: A device that contains a dangerous substance or mixture of substances.
A form that contains important information about a dangerous substance.
A device that is responsible for initiating a dangerous reaction.
Something that is packed within a freight container.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: A device that contains a dangerous substance or mixture of substances.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: “物品”是什么？
options: 盛装一种危险物质或混合物质的设备。
包含危险物质重要信息的表格。
负责启动危险反应的设备。
运输集装箱内包装的东西。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 盛装一种危险物质或混合物质的设备。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: Besides seafarers engaged in the carriage of dangerous goods, who else does the IMDG Code specifically require should be trained in their handling?
options: Shore-based personnel engaged in the handling of dangerous goods.
Pilots.
Port officials.
All persons visiting the ship while she is carrying dangerous goods.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: Shore-based personnel engaged in the handling of dangerous goods.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 除了参与危险货物运输的海员之外，IMDG Code 还专门要求哪些人进行相关处理的培训？
options: 参与危险货物处理的岸上人员。
领航员。
港口官员。
所有到访运输危险货物船只的人员。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 参与危险货物处理的岸上人员。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: What do the letters "IMDG" stand for when we refer to the IMDG Code?
options: International Maritime Dangerous Goods.
Internal Marine Dangerous Goods.
International Marine Danger Group.
International Monitoring Department (Geopolitics).
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: International Maritime Dangerous Goods.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 我们说到 IMDG Code 时，IMDG 这几个字母代表什么意思？
options: 国际海运危险货物
内部海运危险货物
国际海事危险集团
国际监控部门 (Geopolitics)
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 国际海运危险货物

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: Which organization today is responsible for maintaining the IMDG Code?
options: The International Maritime Organization.
The International Hazardous Goods Committee.
The MARPOL 73/78 Advisory Committee.
The Governments of Member States.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: The International Maritime Organization.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 如今由哪个组织负责维护 IMDG Code？
options: 国际海事组织。
国际危险货物委员会。
MARPOL 73/78 顾问委员会。
成员国政府。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 国际海事组织。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: The proper shipping name and UN Number of a substance must be listed on the Dangerous Goods Form. This is so that the substance can be readily identified during transport, especially in the event of an emergency. But which one of the following is also a reason for this?
options: So that the Master has the necessary information to hand if he has to report a pollution incident involving this substance.
To assist in stowage of the package.
To avoid being detained by the authorities for improper documentation when entering port.
To demonstrate compliance with section 6.5 of the ISPS Code.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: So that the Master has the necessary information to hand if he has to report a pollution incident involving this substance.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 物质的适当海运名称和 UN 编号必须列在危险货物表单上。这是为了能够在运输期间轻松识别该物质，尤其发生紧急情况时。但还有一个原因是什么？
options: 为了让船长在不得不报告涉及此物质的污染事故时拥有要提交的必要信息。
为了协助包装的积载。
为了避免在进入港口时被当局由于记录不恰当而扣留。
为了展示对于 ISPS Code 的 6.5 部分的遵从性。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 为了让船长在不得不报告涉及此物质的污染事故时拥有要提交的必要信息。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: If a mixture is above its upper flammable limit, how is the atmosphere described?
options: Too rich.
Too lean.
Saturated.
Inflammable.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: Too rich.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 如果混合物高于可燃上限，如何描述这种气体？
options: 太富。
太贫。
饱和。
可燃。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 太富。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: Which group of dangerous goods is generally understood to be the most dangerous for marine transportation?
options: Organic peroxides.
Toxic gases.
Infectious substances.
Flammable liquids.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: Organic peroxides.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 按照一般理解，对于海洋运输来说以下哪组危险货物最危险？
options: 有机过氧化物。
有毒气体。
感染性物质。
可燃液体。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 有机过氧化物。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: In which of these can you find the Dangerous Goods List?
options: Volume 1 of the IMDG Code.
Volume 2 of the IMDG Code.
The Supplement to the IMDG Code.
MARPOL Annex II
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: Volume 2 of the IMDG Code.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 在哪里可以找到危险货物列表？
options: IMDG Code 的第 1 卷。
IMDG Code 的第 2 卷。
IMDG Code 补编。
MARPOL 附则 II
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: IMDG Code 的第 2 卷。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: Where dangerous goods have been loaded into a road vehicle, what is the name of the form that must be supplied by the person responsible for that operation (assuming the information has NOT been incorporated into the Dangerous Goods Form)?
options: Container / vehicle packing certificate.
Vehicle manifest.
Packing note.
Modular operation transport certificate (MOTC)
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: Container / vehicle packing certificate.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 公路车辆装上危险货物之后，作业负责人必须提供什么表单（假设该信息尚未结合到危险货物表中）？
options: 集装箱/车辆包装证书。
车辆清单。
装箱单。
模块化作业运输证书 (MOTC)
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 集装箱/车辆包装证书。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: Which one of these statements defines a “marine pollutant”?
options: A substance which is subject to the provisions of Annex III of MARPOL.
A substance which, because of its tendency to degrade in seafood, or because of its low hazard potential to the aquatic environment is subject to the provisions of SOLAS and transported accordingly.
A substance which requires the highest form of protection during transportation and is regulated accordingly by the International Transportation Authority.
A substance that discolours the water.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: A substance which is subject to the provisions of Annex III of MARPOL.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 以下哪个陈述定义了“海洋污染物”？
options: 受 MARPOL 附则 III 条款管辖的物质。
由于其在海鲜食品中容易发生变质，后者由于对水生环境的较低危险，受 SOLAS 条款管辖并进行相应运输的物质。
在运输期间需要最高的保护形式，并根据国际运输机构的规定进行相应运输的物质。
在水中掉色的物质。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 受 MARPOL 附则 III 条款管辖的物质。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: Class 2 (Gases) has three divisions. Two of these are “Flammable” and “Non-flammable, non-toxic”. Which of the following is the third division of this Class?
options: Toxic.
Corrosive.
Inflammable.
Reactive.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: Toxic.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 类别 2（气体）具有三个小类。其中两个为“可燃”和“不可燃，非毒性”。以下哪个是此类别的第三小类？
options: 毒性。
腐蚀性。
可燃。
反应性。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 毒性。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: Which one of the following would you consult for guidance on the fire fighting procedures to follow in the event of an incident involving dangerous goods?
options: The EmS Guide.
The MFAG.
MARPOL 73/78.
The International Marine Fire Fighting Directory.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: The EmS Guide.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 发生危险货物事故时，您应该参考哪个选项作为消防程序的指南？
options: EmS 指南。
MFAG。
MARPOL 73/78。
国际海洋消防目录。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: EmS 指南。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: Column 16b of the Dangerous Goods List shows the requirements for segregation. What is segregation in terms of carriage of dangerous goods onboard ship?
options: The way that dangerous goods are separated by location on board.
The requirements for loading and discharging dangerous goods.
The system used in plans showing the stowage of dangerous goods.
Stowage describes the location of dangerous goods horizontally on board a ship, while segregation indicates their vertical separation.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: The way that dangerous goods are separated by location on board.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 危险货物列表的 16b 列显示了隔离要求。对于危险货物船上运输来说，隔离是什么意思？
options: 在船上通过位置进行分离的一种方式。
装卸危险货物的要求。
显示危险货物积载计划使用的系统。
积载描述了船上危险货物的水平分布位置，而隔离指的是垂直分离。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 在船上通过位置进行分离的一种方式。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: Within the IMDG Code, the term “marking” refers to which one of the following?
options: Identification of the substance contained in a package.
Identification of the risks and hazards presented by substances contained in a package.
Identification of the risks and hazards presented by substances contained in cargo transport units.
Damage done to a package of dangerous goods while onboard ship.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: Identification of the substance contained in a package.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 在 IMDG Code 中，“标记”一词指的是以下哪项？
options: 包装内物质的标识信息。
包装内物质所具有的风险和危险的标识信息。
货物运输单元内物质所具有的风险和危险的标识信息。
在船上时对危险货物包装进行的破坏。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 包装内物质的标识信息。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: Which one of the options best describes a multi-element gas container in relation to the IMDG Code?
options: A special arrangement of cylinders and tubes which has a manifold and is assembled within a framework and fitted with service and structural equipment.
A portable tank which is divided by a number of internal bulkheads and is capable of being emptied via a single drain valve.
A number of independent gas cylinders being transported under a single shipment and with the same UN Number.
A gas container which is divided into individual compartments and is capable of simultaneous storage of different gases.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: A special arrangement of cylinders and tubes which has a manifold and is assembled within a framework and fitted with service and structural equipment.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 以下哪个选项最好地描述了与 IMDG Code 相关的多元气体容器？
options: 使用歧管的一种特殊的缸体和管道装置，在框架中组装并且带有服务和结构设备。
便携式罐体，被一些内部舱壁分隔开来，能够通过一个排放阀清空。
在一次运输中运输且具有相同 UN 编号的一些独立气缸。
分成不同舱室的气体容器，能够同时存储多种气体。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 使用歧管的一种特殊的缸体和管道装置，在框架中组装并且带有服务和结构设备。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: When should all placards, orange panels, marks and signs be removed from a cargo transport unit?
options: As soon as the dangerous goods or their residues are discharged.
As soon as the cargo transport unit is discharged from the ship.
Once the cargo transport unit has been loaded and sealed.
Placards, orange panels, marks and signs should never be removed from a cargo transport unit.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: As soon as the dangerous goods or their residues are discharged.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 何时应该从货物运输单元去除所有布告、橙色面板、标记和标志？
options: 危险货物或其残留物取出后立即去除。
从船上卸下货物运输单元后立即去除。
货物运输单元装货且密封后立即去除。
绝不应从货物运输单元去除所有布告、橙色面板、标记和标志。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 危险货物或其残留物取出后立即去除。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: In addition to the IMDG Code, which other book should be referred to for guidance on security matters?
options: The International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Code.
The Seafarers Security Handbook.
The International Maritime Security (IMS) Code.
MARPOL 73/78 (as amended).
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: The International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Code.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 除了 IMDG Code，还应参考哪个书籍作为安全事项指导？
options: 国际船舶和港口设施安全守则 (ISPS) 。
海员安全手册。
国际海洋安全守则 (IMS)。
MARPOL 73/78（修订版）。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 国际船舶和港口设施安全守则 (ISPS) 。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: If you discover a leaking tank container on the weather deck, which of the following actions should you take first?
options: Report it immediately to the Duty Officer.
Wash it away immediately.
Examine the tank container and try and close off any leaking valves.
Make sure the Chief Officer knows about it before arrival, so that no vehicles drive through the spillage.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: Report it immediately to the Duty Officer.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 如果您发现露天甲板上的某个罐体集装箱泄漏，应该首先采取以下哪项措施？
options: 立即报告给值班官员。
立即清洗。
检查罐体集装箱，并尝试关闭任何泄漏阀门。
确保到港之前大副了解此情况，避免车辆驶过溢漏。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 立即报告给值班官员。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: What is meant by the term salvage packaging in relation to the IMDG Code?
options: Special packaging into which damaged, defective, leaking or non-conforming packages or dangerous goods that have spilled or leaked are placed for the purposes of transport for recovery or disposal.
Packaging used only at the direction of a contracted environmental protection response company.
Packaging which is manufactured from recycled material.
Packaging in which goods recovered from the sea are held, pending investigation by the appropriate authority.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: Special packaging into which damaged, defective, leaking or non-conforming packages or dangerous goods that have spilled or leaked are placed for the purposes of transport for recovery or disposal.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 救援包装一词针对 IMDG Code 的含义是什么？
options: 一种特殊包装，用于盛装损坏、有缺陷、泄漏或不符合规范包装或者溢漏或泄漏危险货物的包装，以便进行修复或处置运输。
只能按照环境保护响应分包公司的指令使用的包装。
使用再生材料生产的包装。
盛装海上打捞货物，等待恰当机构进行调查的包装。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 一种特殊包装，用于盛装损坏、有缺陷、泄漏或不符合规范包装或者溢漏或泄漏危险货物的包装，以便进行修复或处置运输。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: According to the IMDG Code, what are “placards”?
options: Large labels that are fixed to the outside surfaces of cargo transport units to indicate the hazards associated with the substances contained in the unit.
The unique identifying numbers assigned to dangerous substances, materials or articles.
Large signs identifying dangerous goods.
Notices that are fixed to the outside surfaces of small packages to provide a warning that the contents of the package are dangerous and present risks.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: Large labels that are fixed to the outside surfaces of cargo transport units to indicate the hazards associated with the substances contained in the unit.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 根据 IMDG Code 的规定，“布告”是什么？
options: 固定在货物运输单元外表面上的大型标签，用于表明单元内盛装物的相关危险。
分配给危险物质、材料或物品的唯一标识号。
标识危险货物的大型标志。
固定在小包装外表面上的通知，警告单元内盛装物是危险货物且存在风险。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 固定在货物运输单元外表面上的大型标签，用于表明单元内盛装物的相关危险。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: Which packing group is assigned to substances presenting a low level of danger?
options: Packing Group I.
Packing Group II.
Packing Group III.
Packing Group L.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: Packing Group III.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 危险较低的物质被归为以下哪个包装组？
options: 包装组 I。
包装组 II。
包装组 III。
包装组 L。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 包装组 III。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: Which one of the following is the most accurate definition of the term “incompatible goods” in relation to the IMDG Code?
options: Those which when stowed together result in a hazardous situation in the event of spillage, leakage or any other accident.
This is just another way of saying “dangerous goods”.
Those which when stowed together with foodstuffs present a risk to health through the leakage of poisonous vapours.
Goods of different classes, as listed in the Dangerous Goods List.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: Those which when stowed together result in a hazardous situation in the event of spillage, leakage or any other accident.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 下面哪个选项是与 IMDG Code 相关的“不能共处货物”一词的最精确定义？
options: 在一起积载时，如果发生溢漏、泄漏或任何其他事故则会导致危险情况的货物。
知识“危险货物”的另一种说法。
与食品一起挤在时会由于泄漏有毒蒸汽导致健康风险的货物。
危险货物列表列出的不同类别的货物。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 在一起积载时，如果发生溢漏、泄漏或任何其他事故则会导致危险情况的货物。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: According to the IMDG Code, what are “labels”?
options: Notices that are fixed to the outside surfaces of small packages to indicate the hazards associated with the substances in the packages.
Large notices that are fixed to the outside surfaces of cargo transport units to provide a warning that the contents of the unit are dangerous goods and present risks.
The unique identifying numbers assigned to dangerous substances, materials or articles.
Large signs identifying dangerous goods.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: Notices that are fixed to the outside surfaces of small packages to indicate the hazards associated with the substances in the packages.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 根据 IMDG Code 的规定，“标签”是什么？
options: 固定在小包装外表面上的通知，用于表明包装内物品的相关危险。
固定在货物运输单元外表面上的大型通知，警告单元内盛装物是危险货物且存在风险。
分配给危险物质、材料或物品的唯一标识号。
标识危险货物的大型标志。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 固定在小包装外表面上的通知，用于表明包装内物品的相关危险。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: Which one of the options identifies where empty, uncleaned cylinders, which have previously contained gas of a toxic nature, be safely stowed, according to the IMDG Code?
options: Only on deck.
Only under deck.
Either on deck or under deck – there is no restriction on empty cylinders.
Empty gas cylinders must be cleaned before they can be accepted for carriage by sea.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: Only on deck.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 根据 IMDG Code 的规定，以下哪项标识了之前盛装有毒气体的、已经清空但尚未清理的缸体可以安全积载的位置？
options: 仅甲板上。
仅甲板下。
甲板上或甲板下 – 清空缸体没有限制。
清空的气缸必须清理之后才能用于海运。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 仅甲板上。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: Which of the following is another name for “smell”?
options: Odour.
Odonate.
Odeum.
Odorant.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: Odour.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 鼻子闻到的味道还叫什么？
options: 气味。
Odonate。
Odeum。
Odorant。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 气味。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: For which one of the following can guidance be found in the Supplement to the IMDG Code?
options: The safe use of pesticides in ships.
The safe handling of animals on board cargo ships and livestock carriers.
Reporting procedures for arrival in quarantined ports.
Anti-piracy measures.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: The safe use of pesticides in ships.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 在 IMDG Code 的补编中可以找到以下哪个选项的指南？
options: 船上杀虫剂安全使用。
货船和牲畜运输船上动物的安全处理。
到达隔离港口的报告程序。
防海盗措施。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 船上杀虫剂安全使用。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: Who is primarily responsible for completing the documents relating to the shipping of dangerous goods (unless the Code specifically requires otherwise)?
options: The Shipper.
The Receiver.
The Master.
The Loading Master at the port of loading.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: The Shipper.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 谁主要负责填写与危险货物运输相关的记录（除非守则专门有其他要求）？
options: 运输商。
收货方。
船长。
装货港口的装货船长。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 运输商。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: Which one of the options describes a requirement of the IMDG Code in respect of the testing of packaging?
options: All packagings must be of a successfully tested design.
Each individual packaging must undergo testing by the manufacturer before use.
Packaging will be subject to testing in the event of leakage or other failure.
The marking on every package must indicate when it was last tested.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: All packagings must be of a successfully tested design.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 以下哪个选项描述了 IMDG Code 关于包装测试的要求？
options: 所有包装均须为成功通过测试的设计。
每个包装在使用前必须经过制造商的测试。
发生泄漏或其他故障时包装要经过测试。
每个包装上的标记必须表明上次测试的时间。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 所有包装均须为成功通过测试的设计。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: According to the IMDG Code, which one of the options identifies the item or items that road vehicles which are used for the transport of dangerous goods must have?
options: Suitable supports and securing attachments which provide a safe and stable platform during transportation.
A yellow flashing light.
Motion sensors which activate a remote alarm if the vehicle breaks loose during transportation by sea.
Suitable bracing arrangements, such that they can be attached to other vehicles and create a more rigid unit during transportation.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: Suitable supports and securing attachments which provide a safe and stable platform during transportation.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 根据 IMDG Code 的规定，以下哪个选项确定了用于运输危险货物的公路车辆必须具有的物品？
options: 恰当的支架和紧固连接件，以便在运输期间提供安全稳定的平台。
闪烁的黄色灯。
动作传感器，如果车辆在海运期间变松则要激活远程报警。
恰当的支撑装置，以便可以连接其他车辆，在运输期间产生更为坚固的单元。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 恰当的支架和紧固连接件，以便在运输期间提供安全稳定的平台。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: What does this symbol indicate in relation to packages used for dangerous goods?
options: The way in which a package should be stored.
The lid of the package.
Where the vents are on the package.
How many packages may be stored on top of this package.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: The way in which a package should be stored.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 此符号表明了与危险货物包装相关的什么内容？
options: 包装的存放方式。
包装的盖子。
包装上的通风位置。
此包装上可以存放多少包装。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 包装的存放方式。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: Which one of the following is a correct statement?
options: The hazard posed by a substance can arise from a dangerous reaction of the substance or article with other substances in the surrounding environment.
Substances in the surrounding environment can have no dangerous impact on packaged dangerous goods.

A dangerous reaction between a substance or article and other substances in the surrounding environment is only possible if those goods are packaged in a container constructed of soft, non-water-resistant material.
The hazard posed by a substance is no higher onboard ship than it is ashore.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: The hazard posed by a substance can arise from a dangerous reaction of the substance or article with other substances in the surrounding environment.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 以下哪项陈述正确？
options: 物质产生的危险可能来自与周围环境中其他物质的危险反应。
周围环境内的物质对包装的危险货物没有任何危险影响。
只有当某种物质和物品包装在一个由柔软的、非防水材料制成的容器内时，才会与周围环境内其他物质发生危险反应。
物质在船上的危险不比在岸上更大。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 物质产生的危险可能来自与周围环境中其他物质的危险反应。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: According to the IMDG Code, where should placards be located on a freight container containing dangerous goods?
options: One on each end and one on each side.
One on each end only.
One on each side only.
One on each end and one visible from directly above.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: One on each end and one on each side.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 根据 IMDG Code 的规定，布告应该贴在危险货物运输集装箱的什么位置？
options: 每端和每侧各一个。
仅每端一个。
仅每侧一个。
每端和从正上方能看到各一个。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 每端和每侧各一个。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: In which part of the diamond-shaped shipping label for dangerous goods would you find the class and division numbers?
options: The lower part.
The upper part.
The left-hand part.
The right-hand part
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: The lower part.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 钻石形状的危险货物标签的哪个部分为类别和小类编号？
options: 下半部分。
上半部分。
左侧部分。
右侧部分
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 下半部分。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: According to the IMDG Code, what is the correct way to store drums containing dangerous goods?
options: Upright.
On their sides.
On pallets and shrink-wrapped, in batches of eight drums.
In a pyramid pattern, not more than three tiers high.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: Upright.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 根据 IMDG Code 的规定，存放危险货物桶的正确方式是什么？
options: 朝上。
侧放。
放在托盘并加上塑料薄膜热缩包装，八个桶一组。
金字塔形状，不超过三层高。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 朝上。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: Which one of the options identifies the first part of any marking on a packaging as required by the IMDG Code?
options: The UN packaging symbol.
The UN Number.
The mark of the authorizing State.
The manufacturer’s mark.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: The UN packaging symbol.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 根据 IMDG Code 的要求，包装上任何标记的第一部分是什么？
options: UN 包装符号。
UN 编号。
授权国的标记。
制造商标记。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: UN 包装符号。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: Corrosive substances can cause severe damage to skin tissue through contact. Which of the following is also a risk with all corrosive substances shipped in packages?
options: That they can damage other cargoes or the ship’s framework if they leak from damaged packaging.
That they will cause toxic vapours to enter the ship’s ventilation system.
That they will create a flammable atmosphere in the hold.
That they will cause anyone entering the affected storage compartment to feel nauseous and disorientated.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: That they can damage other cargoes or the ship’s framework if they leak from damaged packaging.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 接触腐蚀性物质时可能导致严重的皮肤组织损伤。以下哪项也是在包装中运输所有腐蚀性物质的风险？
options: 如果从损坏包装泄漏，则可能损伤其他货物或船只框架。
它们会导致有毒蒸汽进入船只的通风系统。
它们会在机舱内产生可燃大气。
它们会导致进入受影响存储机舱内的人员感到恶心头晕。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 如果从损坏包装泄漏，则可能损伤其他货物或船只框架。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: Can the hazard posed by a substance arise from a dangerous reaction with other substances in the surrounding environment?
options: Yes.
No.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: Yes.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 物质产生的危险可能来自与周围环境中其他物质的危险反应吗？
options: 是。
否。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 是。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: Goods of Class 1 (Explosives) are described as “compatible” if which of the following conditions are met?
options: They can be safely stowed or transported together without significantly increasing the chance of an accident.
They are stowed more than 12 metres horizontally apart within the same compartment, or in a separate compartment.
They contain no live detonators or fuses.
They have been approved by the UN Committee on Classification of Dangerous Goods as mutually insensitive.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: They can be safely stowed or transported together without significantly increasing the chance of an accident.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 类别 1 的货物在满足以下哪个条件时会被描述为“可共处”？
options: 可以在一起安全积载或运输，而不会明显增加事故几率。
在同一个货舱内可以 12 米以上的水平距离进行积载，或积载在不同的货舱内。
它们不包含任何活性雷管或保险丝。
它们经过联合国危险货品分配委员会审核为互相不敏感。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 可以在一起安全积载或运输，而不会明显增加事故几率。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: The classes drawn up by the UN Committee of Experts for the safe handling of hazardous substances are based on which of the following?
options: Alphabetical order.
UN Number.
The type of hazard they present.
Random laboratory tests carried out under the UN guidelines.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: The type of hazard they present.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 联合国危险物质安全处理专家委员会进行的分类是基于以下哪个标准的？
options: 字母数字顺序。
UN 编号。
它们的危险类型。
根据联合国指南进行的随机实验室测试。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 它们的危险类型。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: How many Classes of dangerous goods are there in the IMDG Code?
IMDG Code 中有多少危险货物类别？
How must salvage packaging be specially marked?
options: By the word SALVAGE
By the words EMERGENCY PACKAGING
With the warning CAUTION – SALVAGED GOODS
With the caution DANGER – SALVAGED GOODS
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: By the word SALVAGE

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 应该如何对救援包装进行特殊标记？
options: 标记 SALVAGE 一词
标记 EMERGENCY PACKAGING 一词
标记 CAUTION – SALVAGED GOODS 警告
标记 DANGER – SALVAGED GOODS 警告
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 标记 SALVAGE 一词

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: The proper shipping name and UN Number of a substance must be listed material or article on the Dangerous Goods Form. This is so that the Master has the necessary information to hand if he has to report a pollution incident involving this substance. But which of the following is also a reason?
options: So that the substance can be readily identified during transport, especially in the event of an emergency.
To assist in stowage of the package.
To avoid customs fines for improper documentation when passing through controlled waterways.
To demonstrate compliance with Part B of the ISPS Code.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: So that the substance can be readily identified during transport, especially in the event of an emergency.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 物质的适当海运名称和 UN 编号必须为危险货物表单上列出的材料或物品。这是为了让船长在不得不报告涉及此物质的污染事故时拥有要提交的必要信息。但还有一个原因是什么？
options: 为了能够在运输期间轻松识别该物质，尤其发生紧急情况时。
为了协助包装的积载。
为了避免穿越控制水路时由于记录不恰当而发生海关罚款。
为了展示对于 ISPS Code 的 B 部分的遵从性。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 为了能够在运输期间轻松识别该物质，尤其发生紧急情况时。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: For consignments of dangerous goods, the appropriate emergency information shall be available at all times. Where must it be kept?
options: In a place on board separate from the goods themselves and immediately accessible in the event of an incident.
With the dangerous goods themselves.
In the shore office.
Such emergency information is available by telephone or e-mail at all times directly from the IMO.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: In a place on board separate from the goods themselves and immediately accessible in the event of an incident.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 为了进行危险货物的会签，必须随时能够提供恰当的紧急信息。必须将其保存在何处？
options: 应该保存在与货物本身不同的位置，并且在发生事故时立即可以取用。
与危险货物本身存放在一起。
岸上办公室内。
此类紧急信息随时可通过电话或电子邮件由 IMO 提供。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 应该保存在与货物本身不同的位置，并且在发生事故时立即可以取用。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: Can a cargo transport unit used for the transport of dangerous goods which is found to be damaged, leaking or otherwise losing its contents be accepting for loading? (Select the most correct answer).
options: No.
Yes.
Yes, provided the area around it is regularly swept or hosed down.
Only if the shipper provides a written guarantee to be responsible for any costs resulting from the damage.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: No.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 如果用于运输危险货物的货物运输单元发现损坏、泄漏或其中物品发生其他损失，可以进行装载吗？ （请选择最正确的答案）。
options: 否。
是。
是的，只要周围区域定期清扫或安装向下软管即可。
只有承运人提供书面保证，会对损坏导致的任何成本负责时才可以。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 否。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: Which of the following is a general principle of segregation?
options: Incompatible goods shall be segregated from one another.
Compatible goods shall be segregated from one another.
Incompatible goods must be stowed on separate decks.
Incompatible goods must be stowed in separate compartments, or at least 15 metres apart horizontally within the same compartment.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: Incompatible goods shall be segregated from one another.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 以下哪项是隔离的一般原则？
options: 不能共处的货物应该互相隔离。
能共处的货物应该互相隔离。
不能共处的货物必须积载在不同的甲板上。
不能共处的货物必须在单独的隔间内积载，在同一个隔间内时至少要水平距离 15 米以上。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 不能共处的货物应该互相隔离。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: Why should dangerous cargo be stowed clear of living quarters on the ship?
options: Because of the possibility that dangerous vapours may leak and be drawn into the air intakes and ventilation ducts, entering the accommodation or machinery space.
Because they will be off-loaded first and so should be at the other end of the ship.
Because the area next to the accommodation is designated for the carriage of foodstuffs.
Because there are no hook-up points for the power to drive electrical cooling units; these must all be close to the machinery space according to the Code.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: Because of the possibility that dangerous vapours may leak and be drawn into the air intakes and ventilation ducts, entering the accommodation or machinery space.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 为什么危险货物积载要远离船上住所？
options: 因为危险蒸汽可能会通过进气口、通风管道泄漏并流入舱室、机舱内。
因为它们会首先卸载，因此应该位于船只的另外一端。
因为舱室旁边的区域指定用于运输食品。
因为没有电源连接点来驱动电气冷却设备； 根据守则规定这些设备必须全部靠近机舱。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 因为危险蒸汽可能会通过进气口、通风管道泄漏并流入舱室、机舱内。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: How should marine pollutants be stowed?
options: They should be securely stowed in such a manner as to minimise the risk of them being lost overboard.
They should be stowed “On Deck Only” because of the hazards they present.
They should be stowed adjacent to the living quarters.
It is permitted to stow marine pollutants anywhere within the cargo area of the ship, provided they are at least 6 metres horizontally from the ship’s side.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: They should be securely stowed in such a manner as to minimise the risk of them being lost overboard.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 应该如何积载海洋污染物？
options: 应稳固积载，确保最大程度减小发生舷外损失的风险。
因为存在危险，只应“甲板上”积载。
应该靠近住所积载。
允许在船只货物区域的任何位置积载海洋污染物，条件是离船只侧面水平距离至少为 6 米。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 应稳固积载，确保最大程度减小发生舷外损失的风险。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: The MFAG is written around the substances, material and articles covered by the IMDG Code and which other Code?
options: The IMSBC Code.
The IGC Code.
The ISPS Code.
The IBC Code.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: The IMSBC Code.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: MFAG 是围绕 IMDG Code 和另外哪个守则中涵盖的物质、材料和物品编写的？
options: IMSBC Code。
IGC Code。
ISPS Code。
IBC Code。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: IMSBC Code。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: The reporting of incidents involving harmful substances and/or marine pollutants is regulated under which international regulations?
options: MARPOL 73/78.
Part A of SOLAS 1974.
Appendix B of the Supplement to the IMDG Code.
The EmS Guide.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: MARPOL 73/78.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 涉及有害物质和海洋污染物的事故报告在哪个国际法规中进行了规定？
options: MARPOL 73/78.
SOLAS 1974 的 A 部分。
IMDG Code 补编的附录 B。
EmS 指南。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: MARPOL 73/78.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: If it is safe to do so, how should a spillage of a substance listed as a marine pollutant preferably be dealt with?
options: It should be collected for safe disposal and absorbent material should be used to collect spilt liquid.
It should be washed directly overboard.
It should be sprayed with caustic soda and then washed overboard.
It should be pumped down to the engine-room and held in a spare storage tank until it can be landed to shore.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: It should be collected for safe disposal and absorbent material should be used to collect spilt liquid.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 如果安全的话，最好应该如何处理列为海洋污染物的物质溢漏？
options: 应收集以便进行安全处置，应该使用吸收性材料收集喷洒的液体。
应该直接清洗到舷外。
应使用苛性钠进行喷洒，然后清洗到舷外。
应该泵送到机舱，并保留在备用存储罐内，直到可以上岸。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 应收集以便进行安全处置，应该使用吸收性材料收集喷洒的液体。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: The Medical First Aid Guide for Use in Accidents Involving Dangerous Goods provides advice intended for which of the following?
options: The initial management of chemical poisoning and diagnosis within the limits of the facilities available at sea.
The comprehensive and total management of chemical poisoning and diagnosis to full recovery, with assistance from shore as required.
The transfer of a casualty into shoreside care with full and appropriate medical documentation.
The limited care of casualties in exposure incidents involving liquid chemicals.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: The initial management of chemical poisoning and diagnosis within the limits of the facilities available at sea.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 涉及危险货物事故中使用的医疗急救指南提供了一些建议，旨在用于以下哪个目的？
options: 化学品中毒的最初管理，以及在海上有限的设施范围内进行诊断。
在岸上协助下的化学品中毒全面和综合的管理，以及诊断至完全康复。
伤者到岸上的转移护理，且具有完整恰当的医疗记录。
伤者遭遇液体化学品事故的有限护理。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 化学品中毒的最初管理，以及在海上有限的设施范围内进行诊断。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: Which abbreviation is used to identify a “Marine Pollutant” in the Dangerous Goods List?
options: P
MarPol
SMP
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: P

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 危险货物列表中用于标识“海洋污染物”的缩写是什么？
options: P
MarPol
SMP
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: P

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: What does the EmS number refer to?
options: The relevant emergency schedules for FIRE and SPILLAGE in the Emergency Response Procedures for Ships Carrying Dangerous Goods.
The emergency response procedures as outlined in 46 CFR 32 of the US Federal Code of Regulations and expanded in the USCG Guidelines on the Transportation of Dangerous Goods by Sea.
The relevant guidelines listed in the International Maritime Organization Emergency Anti-Pollution Measures (1974).
The appropriate entry in the Emergency Procedures (Shipping).
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: The relevant emergency schedules for FIRE and SPILLAGE in the Emergency Response Procedures for Ships Carrying Dangerous Goods.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: EmS 编号指的是什么？
options: 船只运输危险货物紧急响应程序中的火情和溢漏相关紧急计划表。
美国联邦法规 46 CFR 32 中列出的紧急响应程序，并在危险货物海运 USCG 指南中得以扩展。
国际海事组织紧急防污染措施 (1974) 中列出的相关指南。
紧急程序（运输）中的相应条目。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 船只运输危险货物紧急响应程序中的火情和溢漏相关紧急计划表。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: What does the abbreviation “IBC” stand for?
options: Intermediate Bulk Container.
Intermediate Bulk Code.
Internal Bulk Construction.
International Booking Code.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: Intermediate Bulk Container.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 缩写“IBC”是什么意思？
options: 中间散货容器。
中型散装守则。
内部散装结构。
国际预定代码。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 中间散货容器。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: What is a “UN Number”?
options: A unique identifying number assigned to a dangerous substance, material or article by the United Nations Committee of Experts on the Transport of Dangerous Goods.
A unique international chemical symbol assigned to a dangerous substance or material.
An emergency contact number for use in the event of an injury or pollution incident involving a dangerous substance as listed in the Dangerous Goods List in the IMDG Code.
An international fire fighting reference number.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: A unique identifying number assigned to a dangerous substance, material or article by the United Nations Committee of Experts on the Transport of Dangerous Goods.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: “UN 编号”是什么？
options: 危险货物运输联合国专家委员会为危险物质、材料或物品分配的唯一标识号。
为危险物质或材料分配的唯一国际化学品符号。
发生涉及 IMDG Code 危险货物列表中列出危险物质的受伤或污染事故时使用的紧急联系号码。
国际消防参考编号。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 危险货物运输联合国专家委员会为危险物质、材料或物品分配的唯一标识号。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: What special mark must a plastic packaging bear if it is recycled?
options: REC
R
RECYCLED
Caution! Recycled Packaging!
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: REC

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 如果某个塑料包装为再生材料，则必须采用哪个特殊标志？
options: REC
R
RECYCLED
Caution! Recycled Packaging!
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: REC

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: How is the technical information displayed on a portable tank?
options: It is stamped on a metal plate, fixed to the tank where it can easily be seen.
It is painted on the front and back of the tank.
It is printed on both sides of the tank.
It is written on a placard fixed to the tank adjacent to the drain valve.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: It is stamped on a metal plate, fixed to the tank where it can easily be seen.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 便携式罐体上技术信息的显示方式是什么样的？
options: 戳记在金属板上，固定在容易看到的罐体位置上。
漆涂在罐体前后。
打印在罐体两侧。
写在固定在排放阀附近罐体的布告上。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 戳记在金属板上，固定在容易看到的罐体位置上。

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: Which of the following is a design feature of all intermediate bulk containers?
options: They must be suitable for handling by mechanical means.
They must be individually approved by the competent authority.
They must be capable of withstanding a drop test of 12 metres.
They must be fitted with a minimum of three pressure-relief valves.
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: They must be suitable for handling by mechanical means.

CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.question: 以下哪项是所有中间散货容器的设计特性？
options: 必须适合商用方式的搬运。
必须经过合格机构的单独审核。
必须能够抵御 12 米的掉落测试。
必须安装至少三个泄压阀。
CD0053 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Basic.answer: 必须适合商用方式的搬运。

CD0054 — COW.question: What is the requirement regarding arrangements for hand dipping the cargo tanks after COW?
options: Arrangements in the aftermost portion of the tank and in 3 other suitable locations.
Arrangements in each corner of the tank.
Arrangements in the middle of the tank
Arrangements in the aftermost portion of the tank and in 4 other suitable locations.
CD0054 — COW.answer: Arrangements in the aftermost portion of the tank and in 3 other suitable locations.

CD0054 — COW.question: What is the purpose of the small diameter line?
options: To be utilised when decanting the slop tank
To discharge ashore the drainings form pumps and lines.
To strip the pump room.
To supply driving media to the eductor.
CD0054 — COW.answer: To discharge ashore the drainings form pumps and lines.

CD0054 — COW.question: What requirements must the person in charge of COW operation meet with regard to the COW Manual?
options: Be familiar with the Manual.
Been instructed in the content of the Manual.
Be fully knowledgeable of the content of the Manual.
Have detailed knowledge of the Manual.
CD0054 — COW.answer: Be fully knowledgeable of the content of the Manual.

CD0054 — COW.question: What are the requirements regarding experience for persons who are intended to have particular responsibilities as defined in the Manual?
options: They shall have at least 6 months experience on oil tankers where they should have been involved in COW operation.
They shall have at least 12 months experience on oil tankers where they should have been involved in COW operation.
They shall have at least 9 months experience on oil tankers where they should have been involved in COW operation.
With regard to experience there is no such requirement.
CD0054 — COW.answer: They shall have at least 6 months experience on oil tankers where they should have been involved in COW operation.

CD0054 — COW.question: How many per cent of the cargo tanks to be crude oil washed on rotational basis for sludge control during a 4 months period?
options: Approximately 25 per cent.
Approximately 50 per cent
Approximately 30 per cent
Approximately 10 per cent
CD0054 — COW.answer: Approximately 25 per cent.

CD0054 — COW.question: Where shall the verification of submerged washing machines be recorded?
options: In the deck logbook.
In the engine logbook.
In the PMS (planned maintenance system).
In the Supplement 2 to the Oil Record Book.
CD0054 — COW.answer: In the Supplement 2 to the Oil Record Book.

CD0054 — COW.question: What is the requirement regarding stripping system capacity when washing bottom of the cargo tanks?
options: There is no requirement to stripping capacity.
The stripping capacity must be 25% more than the total throughput of washing fluid.
The stripping capacity must be 50% more than the total throughput of washing fluid.
The stripping capacity must be 10% more than the total throughput of washing fluid.
CD0054 — COW.answer: The stripping capacity must be 25% more than the total throughput of washing fluid.

CD0054 — COW.question: Water that is put into a tank which has been crude oil washed but not water washed shall be regarded as:
options: Clean ballast.
Arrival ballast.
Dirty ballast.
Segregated ballast.
CD0054 — COW.answer: Dirty ballast.

CD0054 — COW.question: Are we allowed to perform COW at sea?
options: Yes, on ballast passages.
No, we are not allowed to perform COW at sea.
Yes, between discharge ports.
There are no restrictions regarding COW at sea.
CD0054 — COW.answer: Yes, between discharge ports.

CD0054 — COW.question: What kind of action must be taken in the event of total failure of the inert gas system during discharge/COW?
options: Stop the discharge/COW.
Call the Chief Engineer.
Stop the COW and reduce the discharge rate.
CD0054 — COW.answer: Stop the discharge/COW.

CD0054 — COW.question: What is the minimum distance from the nearest land when you are pumping departure ballast overboard?
options: 30 nautical miles.
10 nautical miles.
100 nautical miles.
50 nautical miles.
CD0054 — COW.answer: 50 nautical miles.

CD0054 — COW.question: What is the maximum quantity of oil you are permitted to discharge into the sea from an “existing tanker”?
options: 1/20,000 of the total quantity of the cargo.
1/15,000 of the total quantity of the cargo.
There is no such restriction.
1/30,000 of the total quantity of the cargo.
CD0054 — COW.answer: 1/15,000 of the total quantity of the cargo.

CD0054 — COW.question: According to IMO the Manual has to be approved by the Administration. With regard to general practice who is giving the final approval of the Manual?
options: The classification society.
The IMO.
The coast guard.
The port state.
CD0054 — COW.answer: The classification society.

CD0054 — COW.question: What is the requirement to the number of drive units on vessels equipped with tank washing machines where the drive units are detachable?
options: No particular requirement.
That no drive unit has to be shifted more than 3 times.
That no drive unit has to be shifted more than twice.
That no drive unit has to be shifted more than once.
CD0054 — COW.answer: That no drive unit has to be shifted more than twice.

CD0054 — COW.question: What is the requirement regarding hydrant valves on the COW line?
options: No requirement.
They must be blanked off.
They must be fitted with a special cap.
They must be disconnected.
CD0054 — COW.answer: They must be blanked off.

CD0054 — COW.question: What kind of action to be taken if an alternation affecting the crude oil washing system is made?
options: Advise IMO.
Advise port state.
Revise the Manual.
Advise the coast guard.
CD0054 — COW.answer: Revise the Manual.

CD0054 — COW.question: Where in the tank shall the oxygen level be determined before crude oil washing?
options: 1 metre from the deck and in the bottom of the tank.
In the middle of the tank.
1 metre from the deck and in the middle region of the ullage space.
2 metre from the deck and in the middle region of the ullage space.
CD0054 — COW.answer: 1 metre from the deck and in the middle region of the ullage space.

CD0054 — COW.question: Who is signing the Ship/Shore Safety Checklist?
options: Chief officer.
Ship and Shore Representative.
The surveyor.
The Captain.
CD0054 — COW.answer: Ship and Shore Representative.

CD0054 — COW.question: From how many or which one of the cargo pumps must it be possible to take “bleed-off” from main(s) for COW supply?
options: From 50% of the cargo pumps.
From any one of the cargo pumps.
From at least two of the cargo pumps.
From a particular cargo pump.
CD0054 — COW.answer: From any one of the cargo pumps.

CD0054 — COW.question: Where should you record the crude oil washing after completion?
options: Oil Record Book.
Cow Manual.
Pumping Log.
Inert plant manual.
CD0054 — COW.answer: Oil Record Book.

CD0054 — COW.question: How to avoid vapour emission during filling of departure ballast (non SBT vessel)?
options: By simultaneous ballasting and cargo discharge.
By reduce the IG pressure.
By minimise the amount of departure ballast.
CD0054 — COW.answer: By simultaneous ballasting and cargo discharge.

CD0054 — COW.question: Why was COW made compulsory?
options: To reduce amount of sludge in cargo tanks
To reduce pollution.
To improve cargo outturn.
To prevent corrosion in cargo tanks.
CD0054 — COW.answer: To reduce pollution.

CD0054 — COW.question: What is the requirement regarding capacity of inert gas plant?
options: Same as the discharging capacity.
At least 125% of the maximum discharge capacity.
At least 115% of the maximum discharge capacity.
There is no such requirement.
CD0054 — COW.answer: At least 125% of the maximum discharge capacity.

CD0054 — COW.question: How to avoid excessive electrostatic generation in the washing process due to the presence of water in the crude oil washing fluid?
options: By recirculating cargo in the tank before use as a source of washing fluid.
By discharge at least 1 metre from the tank before use as a source of washing fluid.
By heating the cargo in the tank before use as a source of washing fluid.
Increase the inert gas pressure in the tank before use as a source of washing fluid.
CD0054 — COW.answer: By discharge at least 1 metre from the tank before use as a source of washing fluid.

CD0054 — COW.question: Why is COW more efficient than water washing?
options: Because the cargo is circulated through fixed washing machines.
Because tank corrosion is reduced.
Because of the dissolving property in crude.
Because of the 'splash-back-effect'
CD0054 — COW.answer: Because of the dissolving property in crude.

CD0054 — COW.question: What is the difference between SBT-system and CBT-system?
options: There is no difference.
CBT-system must have separate ballast pumps
SBT-system can utilise cargo pumps/lines for ballast handling.
CBT-system can utilise cargo pumps/lines for ballast handling.
CD0054 — COW.answer: CBT-system can utilise cargo pumps/lines for ballast handling.

CD0054 — COW.question: What is IMO’s requirement regarding the oxygen level in the tank before and during it is crude oil washed?
options: The oxygen level must not exceed 8 % by volume.
The oxygen level must not exceed 10 % by volume.
The oxygen level must not exceed 5 % by volume.
The oxygen level must not exceed 12 % by volume.
CD0054 — COW.answer: The oxygen level must not exceed 8 % by volume.

CD0055 — ODME.question: Who must sign for each completed operation in the Oil Record Book?
options: The Loading Master
The duty rating
The Officer in charge of the operation
The Captain shall sign for each operation
CD0055 — ODME.answer: The Officer in charge of the operation

CD0055 — ODME.question: Which water can be discharged into the sea without using the ODME?
options: Water from slop tanks
Clean ballast water from cargo tanks
Ballast water from segregated ballast tanks (SBT)
Dirty ballast water from cargo tanks
CD0055 — ODME.answer: Ballast water from segregated ballast tanks (SBT)

CD0055 — ODME.question: For how long must you save the Oil Record Book onboard?
options: 1 year
3 months
3 years
5 years

CD0055 — ODME.question: What medium is used to calibrate the ODME?
options: Sea water
Fresh water
Gasoline
Crude Oil

CD0055 — ODME.question: For how long must you save the printouts from the ODME?
options: Until the end of the voyage
3 months
3 years
5 years

CD0055 — ODME.question: Are you allowed to discharge oil while at anchor more than 50 nautical miles from shore.
options: No
Yes

CD0055 — ODME.question: What regulation controls the discharge of oil in to the sea?
options: MARPOL
SOLAS
ISM Code
STCW

CD0055 — ODME.question: How far from the nearest land do you have to be before you can discharge any oily waste or residue into the sea?
options: 50 nautical miles
30 nautical miles
80 nautical miles
150 nautical miles

CD0055 — ODME.question: What is the maximum instantaneous rate at which oil can be discharged into the sea?
options: 30 litres per nautical mile
50 litres per nautical mile
100 litres per nautical mile
10 litres per nautical mile

CD0056 — Assessor Training.question: The Safety Management System requires that the shipping company develops and implements:
options: A system for voyage planning
A system for main engine maintenance
A system to report, analyse and follow up non-conformities, accidents and hazardous situations
A system for managing unplanned maintenance tasks
CD0056 — Assessor Training.answer: A system to report, analyse and follow up non-conformities, accidents and hazardous situations

CD0056 — Assessor Training.question: The ISM code states that the shipping company has to:
options: Develop career plans for all categories of ship personnel
Develop career plans for senior officers
Establish and maintain procedures for identifying any training, which may be required
Develop a training plan for training supervisor and on board training instructors
CD0056 — Assessor Training.answer: Establish and maintain procedures for identifying any training, which may be required

CD0056 — Assessor Training.question: The ISM Code implies that the ship's complement is able to operate their ship in a safe manner and without polluting the environment. Who has the obligation to fulfil this implication?
options: The flag state
The port state
The shipping company
The individual seafarer
CD0056 — Assessor Training.answer: The shipping company

CD0056 — Assessor Training.question: Before a seafarer is allocated to any duty he/she should:
options: Pass a relevant onshore training course
Be given proper familiarisation with the duty
Go through a dedicated computer based training module for the actual duty
Get a good night sleep
CD0056 — Assessor Training.answer: Be given proper familiarisation with the duty

CD0056 — Assessor Training.question: The ISM Code is part of:
options: SOLAS
STCW
MARPOL
High Speed Craft Code
CD0056 — Assessor Training.answer: SOLAS

CD0056 — Assessor Training.question: How many function areas are defined in the STCW95 Convention?
What are the names of the responsibility levels specified in the STCW Code?
options: Management, operational and support
Senior officers, junior officers and ratings
Deck, engine and catering
Management, operational and assistance
CD0056 — Assessor Training.answer: Management, operational and support

CD0056 — Assessor Training.question: What is meant by the expression "Standard of competence"?
options: The level of proficiency to be achieved for the proper performance of functions on board ships.
The level of knowledge needed to understand how a ship should be operated.
The level of understanding needed to demonstrate ability to cope with specific work tasks on board.
The lower performance limit for all types of shipboard personnel.
CD0056 — Assessor Training.answer: The level of proficiency to be achieved for the proper performance of functions on board ships.

CD0056 — Assessor Training.question: Where are the standards of competence for Training Supervisor, Instructor and Assessor specified?
options: The standards of competence are defined in the Convention articles.
The standards of competence are vaguely defined in A-I/6.
The standards of competence are defined in part B.
The standards are not defined anywhere in the STCW Code.
CD0056 — Assessor Training.answer: The standards of competence are vaguely defined in A-I/6.

CD0056 — Assessor Training.question: How many competence elements are defined by NMD in the “Assess Candidate Performance” table?
The tables defining standards of competence have:
options: 4 columns named ^M- competence^M-	knowledge, understanding and proficiency^M-	methods for demonstrating competence^M-	criteria for evaluating competence
4 columns named:^M- function^M- competence^M- knowledge, understanding and proficiency^M- competence evaluation
4 columns named:^M- competence^M- knowledge and understanding^M- proficiency^M- methods for demonstrating competence
3 columns named:^M- competence^M- knowledge, understanding and proficiency^M- criteria for demonstrating competence
CD0056 — Assessor Training.answer: 4 columns named ^M- competence^M-	knowledge, understanding and proficiency^M-	methods for demonstrating competence^M-	criteria for evaluating competence

CD0056 — Assessor Training.question: How many responsibility levels are defined in the STCW Code?
What is meant by competence within the STCW-95 framework
options: The ability to perform activities to the standards required in employment
The knowledge needed for performing a work task
The motivation of the seafarer when coping with a difficult task
The level of understanding of complex work tasks
CD0056 — Assessor Training.answer: The ability to perform activities to the standards required in employment

CD0056 — Assessor Training.question: As an assessor you have been asked to evaluate the competence of an individual with respect to the STCW95 function "Controlling the operation of the ship and care for persons on board at the operational level". Recommend a method for demonstrating competence of practical skills?
options: In-service demonstration
Project assignments
Written tests
Oral tests
CD0056 — Assessor Training.answer: In-service demonstration

CD0056 — Assessor Training.question: What is the main task of Training Supervisor?
options: Co-ordinate and facilitate onboard and onshore training relating to certification requirements.
Train and retrain instructors and assessors.
Fight for money for training activities.
Check that all crewmembers have valid certificates.
CD0056 — Assessor Training.answer: Co-ordinate and facilitate onboard and onshore training relating to certification requirements.

CD0056 — Assessor Training.question: The competence elements for an assessor are described by?
options: Knowledge and proficiency requirements only
Knowledge, understanding and proficiency requirements only
Knowledge, understanding and proficiency, methods for demonstrating competence and criteria for evaluating competence
Criteria for demonstrating competence only
CD0056 — Assessor Training.answer: Knowledge, understanding and proficiency, methods for demonstrating competence and criteria for evaluating competence

CD0056 — Assessor Training.question: You are planning an in-service assessment session. The competence element to be assessed is: “Ensure compliance with pollution prevention requirements” from the function “Controlling the operation/care for persons on board”. Which assessment method would you recommend?
options: Observation in normal operation
Observation of a designed test case
Written exercise
Interview

CD0056 — Assessor Training.question: In STCW '95 standards of competence is defined for?
options: Officers professional certificates only
Only for officers and rating on watch
Competence for master, officers, ratings and other personnel, related to duty and safety functions
The in-service assessor
CD0056 — Assessor Training.answer: Competence for master, officers, ratings and other personnel, related to duty and safety functions

CD0056 — Assessor Training.question: The four letters in STCW Convention stands for?
options: Seafarers' Training, Certification and Watch keeping
Ship owners' Tracking Control World-wide
Ship owners' Training, Certification and Watch keeping
Standards for Training, Certification and Watch keeping
CD0056 — Assessor Training.answer: Standards for Training, Certification and Watch keeping

CD0056 — Assessor Training.question: The training supervisor has asked you to do an in-service assessment of proficiency regarding the competence element “Operate life-saving appliances“ which of the following methods would you recommend?
options: Observation during normal work situations
Written test
Written test and interview
Observation of a designed test case
CD0056 — Assessor Training.answer: Observation of a designed test case

CD0056 — Assessor Training.question: What is the strength of “observations of work activities” as assessment method?
options: Provides high quality evidence of competence
Competence can easily be demonstrated across the full range of operational conditions
Can be used in emergency situations
Easy to evaluate

CD0056 — Assessor Training.question: The training supervisor has asked you to do an in-service assessment of the basic understanding of the competence element “Operate emergency equipment and apply emergency procedures“. Which of the listed methods would you recommend for this task?
options: Observation during normal work situations
Observation in designed test situations
Interview
Computer based multiple choice questions
CD0056 — Assessor Training.answer: Observation in designed test situations

CD0056 — Assessor Training.question: Which of the listed methods are the most objective for assessing the knowledge component in the competence element “Organise and manage the provision of medical care on board“ in the function “Controlling the ship/care for persons on board at the management level”?
options: Observations
Interviews
Projects and assignments
Computer based assessment

CD0056 — Assessor Training.question: Which of the listed methods would you recommend for assessing the understanding of the competence element “Organise and manage the crew” in the function “Controlling the ship/care for persons on board at the management level”?

Projects and assignments
Written test
Computer based assessment

CD0056 — Assessor Training.question: What are interviews useful for?
